```sql
-- decision's items, so after that update it derives again every avatar R1's review withheld under an item this decision
-- answered; and where it derives the posts of the interim seals that ended with the answer, it derives their avatars too.
-- Everything else is 0030's.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."decisions_apply"() RETURNS trigger
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  c public.cases;
  seals_before uuid[];
  ended uuid[];
  listed uuid[];
  open_items integer;
  open_lane smallint;
  oldest timestamptz;
  digests text[];
  confirmed integer;
  reply record;
  answered integer;
  held boolean;
  -- 2d: the avatars to derive again.
  avatars uuid[];
BEGIN
  IF NEW.kind = 'order' THEN
    UPDATE public.intake_items i SET answered_by = NEW.id, outcome = 'restricted_legal'
     WHERE i.id = (SELECT x.intake_item_id FROM public.legal_order_items x WHERE x.id = NEW.order_item_id)
       AND i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.answered_by IS NULL;
    GET DIAGNOSTICS answered = ROW_COUNT;
    IF answered <> 1 THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_decision' USING DETAIL = 'An order decision answers its own item.';
    END IF;
    SELECT count(*), min(i.lane), min(i.created_at) INTO open_items, open_lane, oldest
      FROM public.intake_items i WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.answered_by IS NULL;
    UPDATE public.cases k
       SET state_version = k.state_version + 1,
           last_decided_at = now(),
           lane = coalesce(open_lane, 2),
           oldest_open_at = oldest,
           answered_seq = CASE WHEN open_items = 0 THEN k.intake_seq ELSE k.answered_seq END,
           closed_at = CASE WHEN open_items = 0 THEN now() END
     WHERE k.id = NEW.case_id
    RETURNING k.* INTO c;
    IF c.closed_at IS NOT NULL THEN
      PERFORM public.moderation_apply(ARRAY[c.target_id], true);
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'final' THEN
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(m.id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO seals_before
      FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.case_id = NEW.case_id AND m.kind = 'seal_media' AND m.decision_kind = 'interim';
    UPDATE public.intake_items i
       SET answered_by = NEW.id,
           outcome = CASE NEW.outcome
                       WHEN 'restricted' THEN CASE WHEN NEW.ground = 'illegal' THEN 'restricted_legal' ELSE 'restricted_rule' END
                       WHEN 'not_evident' THEN CASE WHEN i.alleges_illegal THEN 'not_evident' ELSE 'no_violation' END
                       ELSE 'no_violation' END::public.item_outcome
     WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.seq BETWEEN NEW.answers_from_seq AND NEW.through_seq AND i.answered_by IS NULL;
    -- 2d: R1's hold for review ends with the answer to its item: each avatar it withheld is derived again, visible, or
    -- under a reset_avatar of this decision (applied after this row) detached.
    SELECT array_agg(r.media_id) INTO avatars FROM public.avatar_reviews r JOIN public.intake_items i ON i.id = r.item_id
     WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.answered_by = NEW.id;
    PERFORM public.avatar_apply(avatars);
    SELECT count(*), min(i.lane), min(i.created_at) INTO open_items, open_lane, oldest
      FROM public.intake_items i WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.answered_by IS NULL;
    UPDATE public.cases k
       SET state_version = k.state_version + 1,
           last_decided_at = now(),
           answered_seq = CASE WHEN open_items = 0 THEN k.intake_seq ELSE NEW.through_seq END,
           lane = coalesce(open_lane, 2),
           oldest_open_at = oldest,
           closed_at = CASE WHEN open_items = 0 THEN now() END
     WHERE k.id = NEW.case_id
    RETURNING k.* INTO c;
    IF c.closed_at IS NOT NULL AND c.target_type = 'post' THEN
      PERFORM public.moderation_apply(ARRAY[c.target_id], true);
    END IF;
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(s.id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO ended
      FROM unnest(seals_before) AS s(id) WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = s.id);
    IF cardinality(ended) > 0 THEN
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT s.post_id) INTO listed FROM public.seal_posts s WHERE s.action_id = ANY(ended);
      PERFORM public.moderation_apply(listed, false);
      -- 2d: and the ended seals' avatars.
      SELECT array_agg(DISTINCT s.media_id) INTO avatars FROM public.seal_avatars s WHERE s.action_id = ANY(ended);
      PERFORM public.avatar_apply(avatars);
      IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id WHERE a.id = ANY(ended) AND d.author_mail <> 'none') THEN
        -- 3f: a statement of its own; on a post whose order's notice is held the telling this makes owed is held too.
        held := c.target_type = 'post' AND public.order_notice_held(c.target_id);
        UPDATE public.decisions d
           SET ended_interim = true,
               author_mail = CASE WHEN d.author_mail = 'none' AND NOT held THEN 'pending'::public.delivery_state ELSE d.author_mail END,
               informed_at = CASE WHEN d.author_mail = 'none' AND held THEN NULL ELSE d.informed_at END
         WHERE d.id = NEW.id;
      END IF;
    END IF;
    -- 0030 (3f design, section 6.5): a final decision that answered a suspect item, after it answered the items, closes
    -- the account's owed records that a seal opened when no seal of the account is left in force, and releases its hold.
    IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.intake_items i WHERE i.case_id = NEW.case_id AND i.answered_by = NEW.id AND i.suspect) THEN
      PERFORM public.report_close_unsealed(NEW.case_id);
    END IF;
  ELSE
    UPDATE public.cases k SET state_version = k.state_version + 1, last_decided_at = now() WHERE k.id = NEW.case_id;
  END IF;

  IF NEW.kind = 'review' THEN
    UPDATE public.appeals a
       SET answered_by = NEW.id, result = NEW.outcome::text::public.appeal_result, answered_at = now()
     WHERE a.id = NEW.appeal_id AND a.answered_by IS NULL;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'case_changed';
    END IF;
  ELSIF NEW.kind = 'correction' AND NEW.outcome = 'reversed' THEN
    UPDATE public.appeals a
       SET answered_by = NEW.id, result = 'reversed', answered_at = now()
     WHERE a.decision_id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND a.answered_by IS NULL;
  END IF;

  -- 3e: the answer to a reply.
  IF (NEW.kind IN ('review', 'correction') AND NEW.outcome = 'kept') OR (NEW.kind = 'review' AND NEW.outcome = 'partly_reversed') THEN
    FOR reply IN
      SELECT r.action_id, r.on_time, a.subject_account_id
        FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.suspension_replies r ON r.action_id = a.id
       WHERE a.decision_id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND a.kind IN ('suspend', 'terminate') AND r.answered_by IS NULL
       ORDER BY r.action_id
    LOOP
      IF reply.on_time THEN
        PERFORM 1 FROM public.profiles p WHERE p.id = reply.subject_account_id FOR UPDATE;
      END IF;
      UPDATE public.suspension_replies r SET answered_by = NEW.id, answered_at = now() WHERE r.action_id = reply.action_id AND r.answered_by IS NULL;
      IF reply.on_time THEN
        PERFORM public.standing_apply(reply.subject_account_id);
      END IF;
    END LOOP;
  END IF;
  -- 3e: a kept correction of a decision that found no breach withdraws all of its marks together.
  IF NEW.kind = 'correction' AND NEW.outcome = 'kept' THEN
    UPDATE public.unfounded_marks m SET withdrawn_by = NEW.id, withdrawn_at = now()
     WHERE m.decision_id = NEW.reviews_decision_id AND m.withdrawn_by IS NULL;
  END IF;

  digests := array_remove(ARRAY[NEW.facts_digest, NEW.reason_digest, NEW.legal_reference_digest], NULL);
  IF cardinality(digests) > 0 THEN
    UPDATE public.staff_texts t SET decision_id = NEW.id, confirmed_at = now()
     WHERE t.digest = ANY(digests) AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL;
    GET DIAGNOSTICS confirmed = ROW_COUNT;
    IF confirmed <> cardinality(digests) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'text_not_found';
    END IF;
  END IF;
  RETURN NULL;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 15. The release (6.5, 7.7). release_facts, replaced from its text in 0034_release: `quarantined` also asks every avatar
-- the seal lists that no release lists yet, while its row is there and not erased, to have both its files in the
-- quarantine by record, so seal_release refuses (release_not_quarantined) a release whose avatars are still in the store.
-- Everything else is 0034's.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."release_facts"(action uuid)
RETURNS TABLE (reported boolean, their_reference text, answer text, answered_at timestamptz, handed_over_at timestamptz, quarantined boolean, preserved boolean,
               leave_id uuid, leave_from text, leave_reference text, leave_received_on date, leave_untold boolean, leave_untold_until timestamptz, tell_held boolean)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  WITH open_posts AS (
    SELECT s.post_id, s.images FROM public.seal_posts s
     WHERE s.action_id = release_facts.action AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.release_posts r WHERE r.post_id = s.post_id)
  ), part AS (
    SELECT coalesce(array_agg(o.post_id ORDER BY o.post_id), '{}'::uuid[]) AS posts
      FROM (SELECT p.post_id FROM open_posts p ORDER BY p.post_id LIMIT (SELECT x.posts_max FROM public.release_rules() x)) o
  ), open_avatars AS (
    -- 2d: the seal's avatars that no release lists yet.
    SELECT s.media_id FROM public.seal_avatars s
     WHERE s.action_id = release_facts.action AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.releases x WHERE s.media_id = ANY (x.avatar_ids))
  ), standing_leave AS (
    SELECT l.* FROM public.release_leaves l
     WHERE l.notification_id = public.seal_record(release_facts.action) AND l.withdrawn_at IS NULL
     ORDER BY l.recorded_at DESC, l.id DESC LIMIT 1
  )
  SELECT r.reported, r.their_reference, r.answer, r.answered_at,
         (SELECT max(p.delivered_at) FROM public.productions p WHERE p.seal_action_id = release_facts.action AND p.files IS NOT NULL),
         NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM open_posts o
                      WHERE (SELECT count(*) FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.post_id = o.post_id) <> o.images
                         OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.post_media m
                                     WHERE m.post_id = o.post_id AND m.erased_at IS NULL
                                       AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.quarantine_files q
                                             WHERE q.media_id = m.id AND q.returned_at IS NULL AND q.destroyed_at IS NULL) < 2))
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM open_avatars o JOIN public.post_media m ON m.id = o.media_id
                            WHERE m.erased_at IS NULL
                              AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.quarantine_files q
                                    WHERE q.media_id = m.id AND q.returned_at IS NULL AND q.destroyed_at IS NULL) < 2),
         EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM open_posts o WHERE public.post_preserved(o.post_id)),
         l.id, l.leave_from, l.reference, l.received_on, l.untold, l.untold_until,
         NOT public.release_may_tell(l.id, public.seal_record(release_facts.action), (SELECT part.posts FROM part))
    FROM public.seal_report(release_facts.action) r
    LEFT JOIN standing_leave l ON true
$$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 16. seal_release, replaced from its text in 0041_review (6.5): the release also takes every avatar the seal lists that
-- no release lists yet (all of them with the first part, since a seal lists an account's few), writes them to
-- releases.avatar_ids beside post_ids, counts their quarantine's times in backups_clear_at, and erases their rows with the
-- posts' images in one id order. release_not_open only when both lists are empty. The confirmed params and
-- releases_confirmed are unchanged: the avatars are the seal's list, which no caller chooses. Everything else is 0041's.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."seal_release"(action uuid, basis text, leave uuid, staff uuid) RETURNS uuid
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  a public.decision_actions;
  d public.decisions;
  rules record;
  f record;
  l public.release_leaves;
  v_posts uuid[];
  -- 2d: the seal's avatars that no release lists yet.
  v_avatars uuid[];
  v_role text;
  v_since timestamptz;
  v_moved timestamptz;
  v_release uuid := gen_random_uuid();
BEGIN
  SELECT x.* INTO a FROM public.decision_actions x WHERE x.id = seal_release.action;
  IF NOT FOUND OR a.kind::text <> 'seal_media' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_open';
  END IF;
  SELECT x.* INTO d FROM public.decisions x WHERE x.id = a.decision_id;
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cases c WHERE c.id = d.case_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF d.kind::text = 'interim' OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.measures_in_force m WHERE m.id = a.id) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_open';
  END IF;
  SELECT x.* INTO rules FROM public.release_rules() x;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(o.post_id ORDER BY o.post_id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO v_posts
    FROM (SELECT s.post_id FROM public.seal_posts s
           WHERE s.action_id = a.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.release_posts r WHERE r.post_id = s.post_id)
           ORDER BY s.post_id LIMIT rules.posts_max) o;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(s.media_id ORDER BY s.media_id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO v_avatars
    FROM public.seal_avatars s
   WHERE s.action_id = a.id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.releases x WHERE s.media_id = ANY (x.avatar_ids));
  IF cardinality(v_posts) = 0 AND cardinality(v_avatars) = 0 THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_open';
  END IF;
  -- Review M2: an admin too close to the seal's subject (staff_case_conflict, 3c's recusal) is refused before any fact.
  IF public.staff_case_conflict(seal_release.staff, d.case_id, false) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'staff_recused';
  END IF;

  SELECT x.* INTO f FROM public.release_facts(a.id) x;
  IF NOT f.reported THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_reported';
  END IF;
  IF NOT f.quarantined THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_not_quarantined';
  END IF;
  IF f.preserved THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_preserved';
  END IF;

  IF seal_release.basis = 'leave' THEN
    SELECT x.* INTO l FROM public.release_leaves x
     WHERE x.id = seal_release.leave AND x.notification_id = public.seal_record(a.id) AND x.withdrawn_at IS NULL
       FOR SHARE;
    IF NOT FOUND THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_no_leave';
    END IF;
  ELSIF seal_release.basis = 'period' THEN
    IF rules.silence_days IS NULL THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_period_unset';
    END IF;
    v_since := coalesce(f.handed_over_at, (SELECT r.sent_at FROM public.seal_report(a.id) r));
    IF v_since IS NULL OR v_since + make_interval(days => rules.silence_days) > now()
       OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.release_notices n
                       WHERE n.subject_id = a.id AND n.told::text IN ('sent', 'folded')
                         AND n.created_at <= now() - make_interval(days => rules.period_notice_days)
                         AND (n.objection IS NULL OR n.objection_answered_at IS NOT NULL)) THEN
      RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_period_running';
    END IF;
  ELSE
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'release_no_leave';
  END IF;

  SELECT u.role::text INTO v_role FROM auth.users u
   WHERE u.id = seal_release.staff AND u.deleted_at IS NULL AND u.role <> 'user' FOR SHARE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'staff_confirmation_ended';
  END IF;
  IF v_role <> 'admin' THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'admin_required';
  END IF;

  SELECT max(q.moved_at) INTO v_moved FROM public.quarantine_files q WHERE q.post_id = ANY (v_posts) OR q.media_id = ANY (v_avatars);
  INSERT INTO public.releases (id, seal_action_id, post_ids, basis, leave_id, their_reference, released_by, released_at, backups_clear_at, author_notice, avatar_ids)
  VALUES (v_release, a.id, v_posts, seal_release.basis, l.id, l.reference, seal_release.staff, now(),
          greatest(now(), coalesce(v_moved, now())) + make_interval(days => rules.backup_days), 'pending', v_avatars);
  INSERT INTO public.release_posts (post_id, release_id) SELECT p, v_release FROM unnest(v_posts) AS p;
  UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = now()
    FROM (SELECT x.id FROM public.post_media x WHERE (x.post_id = ANY (v_posts) OR x.id = ANY (v_avatars)) AND x.erased_at IS NULL ORDER BY x.id FOR UPDATE) y
   WHERE m.id = y.id;
  RETURN v_release;
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 17. release_replay, replaced from its text in 0034_release (6.5): the replayed release also lists in avatar_ids, and
-- erases, the avatars that the restored database's seal_avatars lists under the gap's seal (its target) and no release
-- lists yet. The params a replay reads name posts alone, as the release's confirmed params do, so the avatars are read
-- from the seal where the restored database holds it. Everything else is 0034's.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."release_replay"(original uuid, posts uuid[], basis text, leave uuid, their_reference text, released_at timestamptz) RETURNS text
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  g public.restore_gaps;
  rules record;
  v_posts uuid[];
  -- 2d: the avatars the restored database's seal lists that no release lists yet.
  v_avatars uuid[];
  v_id uuid := gen_random_uuid();
  v_marked integer;
  v_erased integer;
BEGIN
  IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.releases r WHERE r.id = release_replay.original OR r.replay_of = release_replay.original) THEN
    RETURN 'present';
  END IF;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT p ORDER BY p), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO v_posts FROM unnest(release_replay.posts) AS p;
  SELECT x.* INTO g FROM public.restore_gaps x
   WHERE x.class = 'release' AND x.closed_at IS NULL AND x.action = 'seal_released' AND x.metadata ->> 'releaseId' = release_replay.original::text
     AND x.metadata -> 'params' = jsonb_build_object('postIds', to_jsonb(v_posts::text[]), 'basis', release_replay.basis, 'leaveId', release_replay.leave, 'theirReference', release_replay.their_reference)
   ORDER BY x.place, x.id LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'replay_no_gap';
  END IF;
  SELECT x.* INTO rules FROM public.release_rules() x;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(s.media_id ORDER BY s.media_id), '{}'::uuid[]) INTO v_avatars
    FROM public.seal_avatars s
   WHERE s.action_id::text = g.target_id AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.releases x WHERE s.media_id = ANY (x.avatar_ids));
  INSERT INTO public.releases (id, post_ids, basis, leave_id, their_reference, released_at, replay_of, backups_clear_at, author_notice, imported_at, avatar_ids)
  VALUES (v_id, v_posts, release_replay.basis, release_replay.leave, release_replay.their_reference, coalesce(release_replay.released_at, g.acted_at),
          release_replay.original, now() + make_interval(days => rules.backup_days), 'none', now(), v_avatars);
  INSERT INTO public.release_posts (post_id, release_id) SELECT p, v_id FROM unnest(v_posts) AS p ON CONFLICT (post_id) DO NOTHING;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_marked = ROW_COUNT;
  UPDATE public.post_media m SET erased_at = now()
    FROM (SELECT x.id FROM public.post_media x WHERE (x.post_id = ANY (v_posts) OR x.id = ANY (v_avatars)) AND x.erased_at IS NULL ORDER BY x.id FOR UPDATE) y
   WHERE m.id = y.id;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_erased = ROW_COUNT;
  UPDATE public.restore_gaps x SET closed_at = now(), disposition = 'imported' WHERE x.id = g.id;
  RETURN format('replayed %s %s', v_marked, v_erased);
END $$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 18. The quarantine (7.7: "3d's quarantine service moves a sealed avatar's two files as it moves a held upload's").
-- quarantine_plan, replaced from its text in 0039_known_material: an avatar a seal for good in force lists is moved in
-- (an `in` line) while its row is unerased; an avatar a seal listed and no seal for good lists now, that is not erased,
-- not released and not a held upload, returns (an `out` line), so a lifted seal's avatar is served again; and a file of
-- an avatar a release lists is destroyed as a released post's. Everything else is 0039's.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."quarantine_plan"() RETURNS TABLE (direction text, media_id uuid)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  WITH good AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.post_id FROM public.seal_posts s JOIN public.measures_in_force f ON f.id = s.action_id
     WHERE f.kind = 'seal_media' AND f.decision_kind <> 'interim'
  ), good_avatars AS (
    -- 2d: an avatar a seal for good in force lists.
    SELECT DISTINCT s.media_id FROM public.seal_avatars s JOIN public.measures_in_force f ON f.id = s.action_id
     WHERE f.kind = 'seal_media' AND f.decision_kind <> 'interim'
  ), held AS (
    -- 0039: the image of a refusal that ended as report and is not released counts as sealed for good.
    SELECT u.media_id FROM public.upload_refusals u WHERE u.end_as = 'report' AND u.release_id IS NULL
  ), open_files AS (
    SELECT q.media_id, bool_or(q.unknown) AS unknown,
           bool_or(EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.release_posts r WHERE r.post_id = q.post_id)
                   OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.releases x WHERE q.media_id = ANY (x.avatar_ids))) AS released
      FROM public.quarantine_files q
     WHERE q.returned_at IS NULL AND q.destroyed_at IS NULL AND q.lost_at IS NULL GROUP BY q.media_id
  ), kept AS (
    SELECT q.media_id FROM public.quarantine_files q
     WHERE q.returned_at IS NULL AND q.destroyed_at IS NULL GROUP BY q.media_id HAVING count(*) = 2
  )
  SELECT 'in'::text, m.id FROM public.post_media m JOIN good g ON g.post_id = m.post_id
   WHERE m.erased_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kept k WHERE k.media_id = m.id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'in'::text, m.id FROM public.post_media m JOIN held h ON h.media_id = m.id
   WHERE m.post_id IS NULL AND m.erased_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kept k WHERE k.media_id = m.id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'in'::text, m.id FROM public.post_media m JOIN good_avatars g ON g.media_id = m.id
   WHERE m.erased_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kept k WHERE k.media_id = m.id)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM held h WHERE h.media_id = m.id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'out'::text, o.media_id FROM open_files o JOIN public.post_media m ON m.id = o.media_id
   WHERE NOT o.unknown AND m.post_id IS NOT NULL AND m.erased_at IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM good g WHERE g.post_id = m.post_id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'out'::text, o.media_id FROM open_files o JOIN public.post_media m ON m.id = o.media_id
   WHERE NOT o.unknown AND m.post_id IS NULL AND m.erased_at IS NULL AND NOT o.released
     AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.seal_avatars s WHERE s.media_id = m.id)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM good_avatars g WHERE g.media_id = m.id)
     AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.upload_refusals u WHERE u.media_id = m.id)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'destroy'::text, o.media_id FROM open_files o
   WHERE NOT o.unknown AND (o.released OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.post_media m WHERE m.id = o.media_id)
                            OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.upload_refusals u WHERE u.media_id = o.media_id AND u.release_id IS NOT NULL))
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'operator'::text, o.media_id FROM open_files o WHERE o.unknown
$$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 19. quarantine_counts, replaced from its text in 0039_known_material: a sealed avatar to move in is due since the first
-- seal for good that lists it, and one to return since that seal was lifted, as a post's image. Everything else is 0039's.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."quarantine_counts"() RETURNS TABLE (due_in integer, due_out integer, undestroyed integer, oldest timestamptz)
LANGUAGE sql STABLE SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
  WITH plan AS (
    SELECT p.direction, p.media_id FROM public.quarantine_plan() p
  ), in_at AS (
    -- 0039: a held upload's image is due since its hold ended as report.
    SELECT min(coalesce(f_d.decided_at,
                        -- 2d: a sealed avatar's image is due since the first seal for good that lists it.
                        (SELECT min(d.decided_at) FROM public.seal_avatars s
                           JOIN public.measures_in_force f ON f.id = s.action_id AND f.kind = 'seal_media' AND f.decision_kind <> 'interim'
                           JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = f.decision_id
                          WHERE s.media_id = p.media_id),
                        (SELECT u.ended_at FROM public.upload_refusals u WHERE u.media_id = p.media_id))) AS at
      FROM plan p JOIN public.post_media m ON m.id = p.media_id
      JOIN LATERAL (SELECT min(d.decided_at) AS decided_at FROM public.seal_posts s
                      JOIN public.measures_in_force f ON f.id = s.action_id AND f.kind = 'seal_media' AND f.decision_kind <> 'interim'
                      JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = f.decision_id
                     WHERE s.post_id = m.post_id) f_d ON true
     WHERE p.direction = 'in'
  ), out_at AS (
    SELECT min(greatest(
             (SELECT max(r.created_at) FROM public.seal_posts s
                JOIN public.decision_actions a ON a.id = s.action_id AND a.kind = 'seal_media'
                JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id AND d.kind <> 'interim'
                JOIN public.decision_actions r ON r.reverses_action_id = a.id
               WHERE s.post_id = m.post_id),
             -- 2d: a sealed avatar's files are due back since its seal for good was lifted.
             (SELECT max(r.created_at) FROM public.seal_avatars s
                JOIN public.decision_actions a ON a.id = s.action_id AND a.kind = 'seal_media'
                JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id AND d.kind <> 'interim'
                JOIN public.decision_actions r ON r.reverses_action_id = a.id
               WHERE s.media_id = p.media_id),
             (SELECT max(q.moved_at) FROM public.quarantine_files q
               WHERE q.media_id = p.media_id AND q.returned_at IS NULL AND q.destroyed_at IS NULL AND q.lost_at IS NULL))) AS at
      FROM plan p JOIN public.post_media m ON m.id = p.media_id
     WHERE p.direction = 'out'
  )
  SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM plan WHERE direction = 'in')::integer,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM plan WHERE direction = 'out')::integer,
         (SELECT count(*) FROM public.quarantine_files q JOIN plan p ON p.media_id = q.media_id AND p.direction = 'destroy'
           WHERE q.returned_at IS NULL AND q.destroyed_at IS NULL AND q.lost_at IS NULL)::integer,
         least((SELECT at FROM in_at), (SELECT at FROM out_at))
$$;--> statement-breakpoint

-- 20. erase_case_evidence, replaced from its text in 0018_retention (6.7: an avatar_resets row and an avatar_reviews row
-- are kept as long as their case's evidence and erased by 3c's retention of it): before the holds are released it
-- deletes the avatar_resets rows of the case's decisions' resets and the avatar_reviews rows of the case's items, and
-- counts them among the rows it changed. A reset's 30 days are over by then: the evidence is due 30 days after a reset
-- stopped being in force at the earliest (case_evidence_due_at above). Everything else is 0018's.
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION "public"."erase_case_evidence"(case_id uuid) RETURNS integer
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER SET search_path = public, pg_temp AS $$
DECLARE
  due timestamptz;
  changed integer;
  n integer;
BEGIN
  PERFORM 1 FROM public.cases c WHERE c.id = erase_case_evidence.case_id FOR UPDATE;
  SELECT public.case_evidence_due_at(erase_case_evidence.case_id) INTO due;
  IF due IS NULL OR due > now() THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'not_due';
  END IF;

  SELECT public.erase_snapshots(ARRAY(SELECT s.id FROM public.evidence_snapshots s
                                       WHERE s.case_id = erase_case_evidence.case_id AND s.erased_at IS NULL)) INTO changed;

  UPDATE public.staff_texts t SET text = NULL, salt = NULL, erased_at = now()
   WHERE t.case_id = erase_case_evidence.case_id AND t.confirmed_at IS NULL AND t.erased_at IS NULL;
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  changed := changed + n;

  UPDATE public.appeals a SET statement = NULL, statement_salt = NULL, erased_at = now()
   WHERE a.statement IS NOT NULL
     AND a.decision_id IN (SELECT d.id FROM public.decisions d WHERE d.case_id = erase_case_evidence.case_id);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  changed := changed + n;

  -- 2d: the reset pictures' hashes of the case's resets and R1's holds for review under its items go with its evidence.
  DELETE FROM public.avatar_resets r
   WHERE r.action_id IN (SELECT a.id FROM public.decision_actions a JOIN public.decisions d ON d.id = a.decision_id
                          WHERE d.case_id = erase_case_evidence.case_id);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  changed := changed + n;
  DELETE FROM public.avatar_reviews r
   WHERE r.item_id IN (SELECT i.id FROM public.intake_items i WHERE i.case_id = erase_case_evidence.case_id);
  GET DIAGNOSTICS n = ROW_COUNT;
  changed := changed + n;

  SELECT public.release_case_holds(erase_case_evidence.case_id, NULL) INTO n;
  RETURN changed + n;
END $$;
```

```json
          "name": "decisions_api_all",

          "for": "ALL",

            "korbat_api"
          ],
          "using": "true",
          "withCheck": "true"
        }
      },
      "checkConstraints": {
        "decisions_rule_id": {
          "name": "decisions_rule_id",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "decisions_category": {
          "name": "decisions_category",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "decisions_category_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_TERRORIST_CONTENT')"
        },
        "decisions_automated_decision": {
          "name": "decisions_automated_decision",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" in ('fully', 'partially', 'not_automated')"
        },
        "decisions_territorial_scope": {
          "name": "decisions_territorial_scope",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"territorial_scope\" = 'worldwide'"
        },
        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and ((\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null) or \"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null)) or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_decider": {
          "name": "decisions_decider",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null) = (\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" = 'fully') and (\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'interim')"
        },
        "decisions_match_answer_reason": {
          "name": "decisions_match_answer_reason",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"match_answer_reason\" in ('source_withdrew', 'counsel', 'other')"
        },
        "decisions_informed": {
          "name": "decisions_informed",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"informed_at\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"author_mail\"::text = 'none'"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },
        "decisions_reversal_plain": {
          "name": "decisions_reversal_plain",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" not in ('review', 'correction') or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is null and \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null and \"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null and \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

      "checkConstraints": {
        "intakes_ref": {
          "name": "intakes_ref",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"ref\" ~ '^N-[A-Z2-7]{10}$'"
        },
        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated'"
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff') and (\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\"::text = 'system')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text in ('finding', 'automated')"
        },
        "intakes_automated": {
          "name": "intakes_automated",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text <> 'automated' or (\"intakes\".\"automated_processing\" and (\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2')) and not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" and not \"intakes\".\"csam\" and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },
```

```json
        },
        "post_media_attached_is_complete": {
          "name": "post_media_attached_is_complete",
          "value": "\"post_media\".\"post_id\" is null or (\"post_media\".\"status\" = 'ready' and \"post_media\".\"position\" between 0 and 3 and \"post_media\".\"alt_text\" is not null)"
        },
        "post_media_alt_len": {

        "post_media_import_link": {

          "value": "\"post_media\".\"import_job_id\" is null or \"post_media\".\"imported\""
        },
        "post_media_kind_place": {
          "name": "post_media_kind_place",
          "value": "(\"post_media\".\"kind\"::text = 'post' and \"post_media\".\"profile_id\" is null) or (\"post_media\".\"kind\"::text = 'avatar' and \"post_media\".\"post_id\" is null and \"post_media\".\"position\" is null and \"post_media\".\"alt_text\" is null)"
        },
        "post_media_avatar_owner": {
          "name": "post_media_avatar_owner",
          "value": "\"post_media\".\"profile_id\" is null or \"post_media\".\"profile_id\" = \"post_media\".\"owner_id\""
        },
        "post_media_avatar_sha256": {
          "name": "post_media_avatar_sha256",
          "value": "(\"post_media\".\"kind\"::text = 'post' and \"post_media\".\"avatar_sha256\" is null) or (\"post_media\".\"kind\"::text = 'avatar' and \"post_media\".\"avatar_sha256\" is not null and \"post_media\".\"avatar_sha256\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        "decisions_review_target": {
          "name": "decisions_review_target",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"kind\" in ('review', 'correction')) = (\"decisions\".\"reviews_decision_id\" is not null) and (\"decisions\".\"kind\" = 'review') = (\"decisions\".\"appeal_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "decisions_interim": {
          "name": "decisions_interim",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" <> 'interim' or \"decisions\".\"through_seq\" = 0"
        },
        "decisions_ground_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'incompatible' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is not null"
        },
        "decisions_ground_law": {
          "name": "decisions_ground_law",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_restricted": {
          "name": "decisions_restricted",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"outcome\" <> 'restricted' or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is not null and ((\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is not null and \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is not null) or \"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null)) or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'order'"
        },
        "decisions_decider": {
          "name": "decisions_decider",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is null) = (\"decisions\".\"automated_decision\" = 'fully') and (\"decisions\".\"decided_by\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"kind\"::text = 'interim')"
        },
        "decisions_match_answer_reason": {
          "name": "decisions_match_answer_reason",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"match_answer_reason\" in ('source_withdrew', 'counsel', 'other')"
        },
        "decisions_informed": {
          "name": "decisions_informed",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"informed_at\" is not null or \"decisions\".\"author_mail\"::text = 'none'"
        },
        "decisions_digests": {
          "name": "decisions_digests",
          "value": "(\"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"reason_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') and (\"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null or \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$')"
        },
        "decisions_keyword": {
          "name": "decisions_keyword",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null or \"decisions\".\"ground\" is not distinct from 'illegal'"
        },
        "decisions_law_no_rule": {
          "name": "decisions_law_no_rule",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"ground\" is distinct from 'illegal' or \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null"
        },
        "decisions_reversal_plain": {
          "name": "decisions_reversal_plain",
          "value": "\"decisions\".\"kind\" not in ('review', 'correction') or (\"decisions\".\"ground\" is null and \"decisions\".\"rule_id\" is null and \"decisions\".\"category_keyword\" is null and \"decisions\".\"facts_digest\" is null and \"decisions\".\"legal_reference_digest\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        },

        }
      },

      "checkConstraints": {
        "intakes_ref": {
          "name": "intakes_ref",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"ref\" ~ '^N-[A-Z2-7]{10}$'"
        },
        "intakes_rule_id": {
          "name": "intakes_rule_id",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2', 'R3', 'R4', 'R5', 'R6')"
        },
        "intakes_category": {
          "name": "intakes_category",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category\" in ('STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ANIMAL_WELFARE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CONSUMER_INFORMATION', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_CYBER_VIOLENCE_AGAINST_WOMEN', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_DATA_PROTECTION_AND_PRIVACY_VIOLATIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_ILLEGAL_OR_HARMFUL_SPEECH', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_INFRINGEMENTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NEGATIVE_EFFECTS_ON_CIVIC_DISCOURSE_OR_ELECTIONS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_RISK_FOR_PUBLIC_SECURITY', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SCAMS_AND_FRAUD', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_SELF_HARM', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_UNSAFE_AND_PROHIBITED_PRODUCTS', 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_VIOLENCE')"
        },
        "intakes_category_keyword": {
          "name": "intakes_category_keyword",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"category_keyword\" in ('KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL', 'KEYWORD_CHILD_SEXUAL_ABUSE_MATERIAL_DEEPFAKE', 'KEYWORD_GROOMING_SEXUAL_ENTICEMENT_MINORS')"
        },
        "intakes_cited_law_len": {
          "name": "intakes_cited_law_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"cited_law\") <= 300"
        },
        "intakes_explanation_len": {
          "name": "intakes_explanation_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"intakes\".\"explanation\") <= 2000"
        },
        "intakes_has_ground": {
          "name": "intakes_has_ground",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated'"
        },
        "intakes_illegal_elements": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_elements",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'user' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"bona_fide\" and (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is not null or \"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is not null))"
        },
        "intakes_finding_legal": {
          "name": "intakes_finding_legal",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\" <> 'finding' or not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\""
        },
        "intakes_illegal_not_tc": {
          "name": "intakes_illegal_not_tc",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" or \"intakes\".\"category\" <> 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_OTHER_VIOLATION_TC'"
        },
        "intakes_csam": {
          "name": "intakes_csam",
          "value": "not \"intakes\".\"csam\" or (\"intakes\".\"category\" = 'STATEMENT_CATEGORY_PROTECTION_OF_MINORS' and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_contact_signed_out": {
          "name": "intakes_contact_signed_out",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out'"
        },
        "intakes_reporter_signed_in": {
          "name": "intakes_reporter_signed_in",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_in'"
        },
        "intakes_finding": {
          "name": "intakes_finding",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is not null) and (\"intakes\".\"kind\" = 'finding') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'staff') and (\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text = 'automated') = (\"intakes\".\"channel\"::text = 'system')"
        },
        "intakes_lookup": {
          "name": "intakes_lookup",
          "value": "(\"intakes\".\"lookup_hash\" is not null) = (\"intakes\".\"channel\" = 'signed_out' or \"intakes\".\"csam\")"
        },
        "intakes_erased": {
          "name": "intakes_erased",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"erased_at\" is null or (\"intakes\".\"explanation\" is null and \"intakes\".\"cited_law\" is null)"
        },
        "intakes_r2_finding_only": {
          "name": "intakes_r2_finding_only",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is distinct from 'R2' or \"intakes\".\"kind\"::text in ('finding', 'automated')"
        },
        "intakes_automated": {
          "name": "intakes_automated",
          "value": "\"intakes\".\"kind\"::text <> 'automated' or (\"intakes\".\"automated_processing\" and (\"intakes\".\"rule_id\" is null or \"intakes\".\"rule_id\" in ('R1', 'R2')) and not \"intakes\".\"alleges_illegal\" and not \"intakes\".\"csam\" and \"intakes\".\"reporter_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"contact_id\" is null and \"intakes\".\"finding_by\" is null)"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        },

        }

          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"kind\" in ('tco_removal', 'dsa_art9', 'dsa_art10')"
        },
        "legal_orders_member_state": {
          "name": "legal_orders_member_state",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"member_state\" ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'"
        },
        "legal_orders_names": {
          "name": "legal_orders_names",
          "value": "char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"authority\") between 1 and 200 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"reference\") between 1 and 200"

          "name": "legal_orders_channel",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"channel\" in ('mailbox', 'portal', 'post', 'other')"
        },
        "legal_orders_opened_via": {
          "name": "legal_orders_opened_via",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"opened_via\" in ('console', 'cli')"
        },
        "legal_orders_received": {
          "name": "legal_orders_received",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"received_at\" <= \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\" and \"legal_orders\".\"sent_at\" <= \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\""
        },
        "legal_orders_issued": {
          "name": "legal_orders_issued",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"issued_at\" <= coalesce(\"legal_orders\".\"received_at\", \"legal_orders\".\"opened_at\")"
        },
        "legal_orders_tco": {
          "name": "legal_orders_tco",
          "value": "((\"legal_orders\".\"kind\" <> 'tco_removal' and not \"legal_orders\".\"section_c\") or \"legal_orders\".\"withhold_from_author\") and (\"legal_orders\".\"kind\" <> 'tco_removal' or \"legal_orders\".\"preserve\")"
        },
        "legal_orders_tell": {
          "name": "legal_orders_tell",
          "value": "(\"legal_orders\".\"tell_person\" is null or (\"legal_orders\".\"tell_person\" in ('at_effect', 'at_instant', 'never') and \"legal_orders\".\"kind\" = 'dsa_art10')) and (\"legal_orders\".\"tell_person_at\" is not null) = (\"legal_orders\".\"tell_person\" is not distinct from 'at_instant')"
        },
        "legal_orders_hold_end": {
          "name": "legal_orders_hold_end",
          "value": "(\"legal_orders\".\"hold_ended_at\" is null) = (\"legal_orders\".\"hold_end_reason\" is null) and \"legal_orders\".\"hold_end_reason\" in ('not_authentic', 'annulled', 'released_by_authority', 'not_ordered')"
        },
        "legal_orders_texts_len": {
          "name": "legal_orders_texts_len",
          "value": "char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"verified_how\") <= 500 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"hold_basis\") <= 500 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"scope\") <= 500 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"reasons\") <= 4000 and char_length(\"legal_orders\".\"redress\") <= 4000"
        },
        "legal_orders_document": {
          "name": "legal_orders_document",
          "value": "\"legal_orders\".\"document_sha256\" ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$' and \"legal_orders\".\"document_bytes\" >= 0"
        }
      },
      "isRLSEnabled": true
    },

        },
        "authority_notifications_duties": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_duties",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"duties\" <@ array['dsa18_1', 'dsa18_2', 'tco14_5', 'voluntary']::text[]"
        },
        "authority_notifications_sent_kinds": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_sent_kinds",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_kinds\" <@ array['handle', 'address', 'created_at', 'post_ids', 'post_times', 'report_time', 'files']::text[]"
        },
        "authority_notifications_answer": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_answer",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"answer\" in ('not_illegal', 'illegal', 'no_assessment', 'other')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_opened_via": {

          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"opened_via\" in ('system', 'cli')"
        },
        "authority_notifications_seal": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_seal",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"opened_via\" = 'system') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"seal_action_id\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_closed": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_closed",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" = 'owed') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"closed_at\" is null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_declined": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_declined",
          "value": "(\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" = 'declined') = (\"authority_notifications\".\"declined_reason\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_sent": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_sent",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"state\" <> 'sent' or (\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_at\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"authority\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"channel\" is not null and \"authority_notifications\".\"sent_kinds\" is not null and cardinality(\"authority_notifications\".\"duties\") > 0 and \"authority_notifications\".\"not_kept_version\" is not null)"
        },
        "authority_notifications_answered": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_answered",
          "value": "\"authority_notifications\".\"answer\" is null or \"authority_notifications\".\"answered_at\" is not null"
        },
        "authority_notifications_texts": {
          "name": "authority_notifications_texts",
          "value": "char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"check_reason\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"state_basis\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"declined_reason\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"checked_by\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"sent_by\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"authority\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"channel\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"receipt\") <= 500 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"own_reference\") <= 200 and char_length(\"authority_notifications\".\"their_reference\") <= 200"
```

```ts
import {
  AppealsReviewedParams,
  CaseDecidedParams,
  MEASURES,
  MEASURE_KINDS,
  ORDER_DRAFTS,
  RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX,
  RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY,
  SEAL_DRAFTS,
  STANDING_DAYS,
  STANDING_DRAFTS,
  STANDING_RULES,
  appealDeadline,
  compareDecisionActions,
  isRetiredPlaceholder,
  sealFactsDraft,
  snapshotDigest,
  statementMatchKind,
  staffTextProblem,
  textDigest,
  type ActionKind,
  type CaseAppeal,
  type CaseDecision,
  type CaseDecisionAction,
  type CaseItem,
  type CaseSignal,
  type CaseSnapshot,
  type CaseView,
  type DecisionActionParams,
  type MatchAnswerReason,
  type MeasureTarget,
  type MeasureKind,
  type OrderGround,
  type ReversalKind,
  type RuleId,
  type StaffMe,
  type StaffTextDraft,
  type TdbCategory,
} from "@korbat/contracts";
import { REDRESS_VERSION, RULES_VERSION, STATEMENT_WORDS, type StatementInput } from "@korbat/rules";
import type { StaffApi } from "./api";
import { AUTOMATION_WORDS, codeOf, COMPOSER_WORDS, describeError, messageFor, NOTE_WORDS, STANDING_WORDS } from "./messages";
import { parseCaseId, type CaseId } from "./router";
import { decideWithKey, reviewWithKey } from "./step-up";
import { normalised, saveStaffText, type RandomBytes } from "./texts";
import type { CredentialsLike } from "./webauthn";

/**
 * The decision composer's pure parts (3c design, sections 7.5 and 8): what it offers to whom, the params it builds from
 * what the page shows, the statement it previews, and the confirmation by the key. The page builds every param itself,
 * from the case it displayed and from digests it computed, so what the key confirms is the console's own reading and
 * never a value an answer chose. The database checks every rule again; what is decided here is only what is offered.
 */

export type StaffRole = StaffMe["role"];

/** The texts a decision or a correction carries, by their kind. */
export const DRAFT_TEXT_KINDS = ["facts", "reason", "legal_reference", "review_reason"] as const;
export type DraftTextKind = (typeof DRAFT_TEXT_KINDS)[number];

/** A text as it was saved on the case: its id, the text as saved, and the salt and digest the console drew and computed. */
export interface SavedText {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  salt: string;
  digest: string;
}

/**
 * The composer's draft for one case, which the store keeps across a sign-in by the same handle: the kind of decision,
 * what it decides and does, each text as its person typed it, and the texts already saved. A correction names the
 * decision it corrects, and its actions are reversals; a review names the decision whose appeal it answers, says which
 * of the three answers it gives (`review`), and its actions are reversals too; any other draft's are measures, and the
 * lifts of withholds taken while deciding.
 */
export interface CaseDraft {
  caseId: CaseId;
  kind: "interim" | "final" | "correction" | "review";
  reviewsDecisionId: string | null;
  /** A review's answer, as its person chose it: keep the decision, reverse part of it, or reverse it. */
  review?: AppealsReviewedParams["outcome"];
  outcome: "restricted" | "no_violation" | "not_evident";
  ground: "incompatible" | "illegal";
  ruleId: RuleId;
  category: TdbCategory;
  /** The checkbox of a decision on the law: terrorist content. */
  terrorist: boolean;
  actions: DecisionActionParams[];
  written: Record<DraftTextKind, string>;
  texts: Partial<Record<DraftTextKind, SavedText>>;
  /** 3e: a correction that answers the person's reply: Keep (the outcome `kept`, nothing lifted) or Reverse (the lift). */
  answer?: "kept" | "reversed";
  /** 3e: a correction that withdraws an announced measure for another, signed `replaced`. */
  replaced?: boolean;
  /** 3e Task 5: the items a final decision that finds no breach marks "manifestly unfounded", which the key signs. */
  unfounded?: string[];
  /** 3e Task 5: a correction kept that withdraws every mark of the "No breach" decision it corrects. */
  withdrawMarks?: boolean;
  /** 3f Task 3: a correction that reinstates a post after an order, its ground signed on its one action. */
  reinstate?: boolean;
  /**
   * 3d Task 7 (section 8.4): the reason of an answer without a seal on a case whose match acts, one of
   * MATCH_ANSWER_REASONS, which the key signs. Nothing is chosen when the composer opens.
   */
  matchAnswerReason?: MatchAnswerReason | null;
}

/** The composer's own sentences, each written once. The seal's drafts are the contracts', and the statement's words the rulebook package's. */
export const COMPOSER = {
  closed: "This case is closed. A new report about its target opens a new case; a restriction of this one that is still in force can be corrected.",
  adminFinal: "A final decision on this case, whatever its outcome, is an admin's.",
  unseen: "This post's images cannot be opened now. A report about an image that you answer now is answered unseen: its sender is told so and may ask again.",
  noEffect:
    "This changes nothing anyone sees now. It is recorded as a measure of its own, stays in force should the other restriction be reversed, and its author is told (not for a measure taken while deciding on a deleted post).",
  noteAdvicePost:
    "To record that you read a new urgent item, save your Art. 18 check as a note: a note saved after the item arrived ends its urgent-lane mails. A measure taken while deciding here changes nothing and mails its author at once.",
  noteAdviceAccount:
    "To record that you read a new urgent item, save your Art. 18 check as a note: a note saved after the item arrived ends its urgent-lane mails. Reset the display name or bio while deciding only when it carries what was reported: a reset mails its author at once.",
  onlySealEnds: "Only the seal, a recorded choice not to seal, or an admin's answer ends the urgent mails.",
  noteEnds: "To record that you read a new urgent item, save your Art. 18 check as a note: a note saved after the item arrived ends its urgent-lane mails.",
  neverWrite: "Never write that the images are child sexual abuse material: nobody at korbat has seen them.",
  declineWords:
    "Record why you do not seal now. This ends the urgent mails for the reports that have arrived so far, until an image is posted that this case reaches; an admin still answers the case. Every staff member sees this choice on the home screen for 30 days.",
  declined: "Your choice not to seal is recorded.",
  admin: {
    endsFreeze: "A final decision without a seal ends this case's freeze: staff may then open these images unless another open report or a seal still covers them, and every staff account is mailed.",
    unseen:
      "You decide without seeing the images. Seal for good, and report, when the report's words, the post's text or alt texts, or the account's conduct give a concrete reason to believe the report; answer without a seal when they give none. Say which it was in the facts.",
    answersEarlier: "Your answer also answers the reports on other grounds that arrived before the newest report of this kind, unseen; their senders are told so and may ask again.",
    afterwards:
      "After an answer without a seal the case's images may be opened: whoever is on duty opens the case's target the same day and, where an image breaks a rule or the law, opens a finding on the post and decides it (if it is what the report said, a finding citing R2, which freezes again). When a new report of this kind arrives before that decision is made, the admin's next answer carries the measure for what staff saw, and its facts say when the images were seen. An admin's answer never restricts under another rule on a report's words alone about an image nobody at korbat has opened: that report is answered unseen, and its sender may ask again.",
  },
  personalData: `${COMPOSER_WORDS.personalDataRule} ${COMPOSER_WORDS.toAuthor}`,
  staysOpen: (throughSeq: number, left: number) =>
    `This decision answers the items up to the newest report of child sexual abuse material (item ${throughSeq}). The reports on other grounds that arrived after it stay open (${left} ${left === 1 ? "item" : "items"}), to be judged with the images once the freeze has ended.`,
  sealInError: "Lift a seal taken while deciding only when it was taken in error: on the wrong case, or on a report that gives no reason to believe it.",
  sealForGood:
    "A seal for good is lifted only on the authority's answer that the images are not child sexual abuse material. Say in the reason that the authority has answered, and the date of its answer. Never write its reference or anything that names a person: the reference stays in the operator's records, off the server.",
  previewNeedsMeasure: "The statement appears here once a measure is chosen.",
  incomplete:
    "This decision is not complete yet: a restriction needs a measure, its facts and its reason, and on the law its legal reference; a correction needs something to lift and its reason; a review needs its reason, and lifts nothing when it keeps the decision, something when it reverses part, and everything still in force when it reverses; an answer to a report of child sexual abuse material needs its facts.",
  freshSnapshot: "The case's newest snapshot could not be shown, so a fresh one was taken and is shown above. Check it, then confirm again.",
  recorded: "The decision is recorded.",
  reviewed: "The review is recorded: the appeal is answered, and its author is told.",
  reviewLabel: "Review the appeal",
  leftForLater: (count: number) => `The reports on other grounds that arrived after the newest report of child sexual abuse material stay open (${count} ${count === 1 ? "item" : "items"}), to be judged with the images once the freeze has ended.`,
  arrivedSince: (count: number) => `${count === 1 ? "1 new item arrived" : `${count} new items arrived`} since this page read the case: ${count === 1 ? "it stays" : "they stay"} open.`,
  interimStays: (measures: string) => `The case stays open, so what was done while deciding stays in force: ${measures}.`,
  alreadyHidden: "This case already hides the post while it is decided.",
  liftLabel: "Lift what was done while deciding",
  correctLabel: "Correct this decision",
} as const;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- what a case holds

/** The items no decision has answered yet. */
const unanswered = (view: CaseView): CaseItem[] => view.items.filter((item) => item.outcome === null);

/** The unanswered suspect items: reports and findings of child sexual abuse material that still wait for an admin. */
export const suspectOpen = (view: CaseView): CaseItem[] => unanswered(view).filter((item) => item.suspect);

/** Whether a final decision on the case would be an admin's: it holds an unanswered suspect item or one citing R5. */
export function finalNeedsAdmin(view: CaseView): boolean {
  return unanswered(view).some((item) => item.suspect || item.ruleId === "R5");
}

/** The kinds of decision offered: none on a closed case, and to someone who is no admin only "While deciding" where the final decision needs one. */
export function kindsOffered(view: CaseView, role: StaffRole): ("interim" | "final")[] {
  if (view.closedAt !== null) return [];
  return finalNeedsAdmin(view) && role !== "admin" ? ["interim"] : ["interim", "final"];
}

/**
 * The last item a final decision made now answers: the newest item the page showed or, on a case that holds an unanswered
 * suspect item, the newest of those, so that the reports on other grounds that arrived after it stay open and are judged
 * with the images once the freeze has ended.
 */
export function throughSeqOf(view: CaseView): number {
  const suspect = suspectOpen(view);
  return Math.max(0, ...(suspect.length > 0 ? suspect : view.items).map((item) => item.seq));
}

/** The unanswered items a final decision made now would leave open: those that arrived after the newest unanswered suspect item. */
export function leftOpen(view: CaseView): CaseItem[] {
  const through = throughSeqOf(view);
  return unanswered(view).filter((item) => item.seq > through);
}

/** The items a decision of this kind considers: a final one those it answers, one taken while deciding every unanswered item. */
function considered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): CaseItem[] {
  const through = throughSeqOf(view);
  return unanswered(view).filter((item) => kind === "interim" || item.seq <= through);
}

/** Whether the ground of the law is offered: a considered item must allege illegality. */
export const lawOffered = (view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): boolean => considered(view, kind).some((item) => item.allegesIllegal);

/** The outcomes offered: a decision taken while deciding restricts; a final one restricts or finds no breach, or, where an item alleges illegality, that it is not evident. */
export function outcomesOffered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): CaseDraft["outcome"][] {
  if (kind === "interim") return ["restricted"];
  return lawOffered(view, "final") ? ["restricted", "no_violation", "not_evident"] : ["restricted", "no_violation"];
}

/**
 * The outcomes the composer lists from the start: those of every kind this person may decide. Someone who may only decide
 * "While deciding" sees the restriction alone; anyone who may decide the case sees No breach, and Illegality not evident
 * where an item alleges illegality, before a kind is chosen.
 */
export function outcomesListed(view: CaseView, role: StaffRole): CaseDraft["outcome"][] {
  return kindsOffered(view, role).includes("final") ? outcomesOffered(view, "final") : ["restricted"];
}

/**
 * The measures this target and kind allow, but the seal, which has a control of its own: offered whatever the target's
 * level, but for one the database always refuses. A second withhold of the post while deciding, while this case's own
 * withhold taken while deciding is in force, is such a one; the page says instead that the case hides the post already.
 */
export function measuresOffered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final"): MeasureKind[] {
  // 3e: an account case's final decision may also retire the handle (8.3); its other standing measures come with their tasks.
  // 2d Task 4 (design, section 7.7): and reset the profile picture, interim or final, where it offers "Reset display name".
  const targets = view.target.type === "post" ? ["post", "image"] : ["display_name", "bio", "avatar", "handle"];
  return MEASURE_KINDS.filter((measure) => measure !== "seal_media" && MEASURES[measure][kind] && targets.includes(MEASURES[measure].target) && !(kind === "interim" && measure === "withhold" && hiddenWhileDeciding(view)));
}

/**
 * 3e (design, section 8.3): whether "Retire the handle" is open. It is greyed with [retire.none] while the profile holds a
 * placeholder: there is no handle to retire, and the database would retire the placeholder of a fresh snapshot.
 */
export const retireOpen = (view: CaseView): boolean => view.target.type === "account" && !(view.target.handle !== null && isRetiredPlaceholder(view.target.handle.toLowerCase()));

/**
 * 2d Task 4: whether the newest shown snapshot of an account copied a profile picture (its media lists one), or null when no
 * snapshot is shown.
 */
const snapshotPicture = (view: CaseView): boolean | null => {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  return newest && !newest.withheld ? (newest.media ?? []).length > 0 : null;
};

/** The handle the newest shown snapshot copied, in lower case as the database retires it; null when no snapshot shows one. */
const snapshotHandle = (view: CaseView): string | null => {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  return newest && !newest.withheld && newest.handle !== null ? newest.handle.toLowerCase() : null;
};

/** [retire.moved]: the profile's handle now differs from the one the newest snapshot copied, which is the one a retirement names. */
export function retireMoved(view: CaseView): boolean {
  const copied = snapshotHandle(view);
  return view.target.type === "account" && copied !== null && view.target.handle !== null && view.target.handle.toLowerCase() !== copied;
}

/**
 * What the preview prints for a retirement's placeholder. The database makes it from the measure's id, which does not
 * exist before the decision is recorded, so the preview prints the prefix and twelve x in place of the hex digits: the
 * placeholder's length and form, and plainly not one the author could meet.
 */
export const PREVIEW_PLACEHOLDER = `${RETIRED_HANDLE_PREFIX}${"x".repeat(12)}`;

/** Whether this case hides its post while it is decided: a withhold taken while deciding is in force. */
export const hiddenWhileDeciding = (view: CaseView): boolean => interimInForce(view).some(({ action }) => action.kind === "withhold");

/**
 * The images an image measure of this kind can name: those of the newest shown snapshot, but, while deciding, not an
 * image a withhold of this case taken while deciding already holds back, which the database refuses to withhold twice.
 */
export function imagesOffered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final", measure: MeasureKind): string[] {
  const held = kind === "interim" && measure === "withhold_media" ? new Set(interimInForce(view).filter(({ action }) => action.kind === "withhold_media").map(({ action }) => action.mediaId)) : new Set<string | null>();
  return snapshotImages(view).filter((image) => !held.has(image));
}

/** Whether the seal is offered: on a case with an unanswered suspect item that reaches an image; while deciding to anyone eligible, for good to an admin. */
export function sealOffered(view: CaseView, kind: "interim" | "final", role: StaffRole): boolean {
  return suspectOpen(view).length > 0 && (view.suspicion?.reach.images ?? 0) > 0 && (kind === "interim" || role === "admin");
}

/** The images the newest shown snapshot lists, by id: what an image measure can name. */
export function snapshotImages(view: CaseView): string[] {
  const newest = view.snapshots[0];
  return newest && !newest.withheld ? (newest.media ?? []).map((image) => image.id) : [];
}

/**
 * Whether a measure would change nothing now, as far as the page can tell: the post is deleted or already not shown,
 * the image already held back by a measure of this case, the field already the placeholder, the account deleted. The
 * database decides when the measure is recorded; this is what the composer says beside it and what the preview shows.
 * `standing` is the kind of the decision the measure would belong to, which a seal's answer turns on, and so does what
 * the decision ends first. The database ends what was done while deciding before it writes a final decision's measures:
 * every such measure when the decision closes the case, and a seal taken while deciding when it answers the suspect
 * items. What ends then holds nothing back: a post that only this case's withhold hid is visible again, and the measure
 * changes what everyone sees.
 */
export function noEffectOf(view: CaseView, action: DecisionActionParams, standing: "interim" | "final" = "interim"): "already" | "deleted" | null {
  const { target } = view;
  const closes = standing === "final" && leftOpen(view).length === 0;
  const ending = new Set(standing === "final" ? interimInForce(view).filter(({ action: held }) => (held.kind === "seal_media" ? suspectOpen(view).length > 0 : closes)).map(({ action: held }) => held.id) : []);
  const spec = MEASURES[action.kind];
  if (spec.lifts !== null) return null;
  if (action.kind === "seal_media") {
    // A seal on a deleted target changes nothing anyone sees. On a post, neither does one whose images a seal of this case
    // of at least its standing already holds: any seal for one taken while deciding, a seal for good for one for good. On
    // an account a second seal may cover images posted since, which the page cannot tell: it says nothing there.
    if (target.type === "account") return target.deleted ? "deleted" : null;
    if (target.state === "deleted_by_author") return "deleted";
    const held = view.decisions.filter((decided) => decided.actions.some((other) => other.kind === "seal_media" && other.inForce));
    return held.some((decided) => standing === "interim" || decided.kind === "final") ? "already" : null;
  }
  if (target.type === "account") {
    if (target.deleted) return "deleted";
    // 3e: a retirement changes nothing when the newest snapshot's handle is retired already, which the case answer says.
    if (action.kind === "retire_handle") return view.standing?.snapshotHandleRetired ? "already" : null;
    if (action.kind === "reset_display_name") return target.displayName !== null && target.displayName === target.handle ? "already" : null;
    // 2d Task 4: a reset of the picture changes nothing when the account has none. The case answer names the account's fields
    // and not its picture, so the newest snapshot the page shows says it, as the reset compares with that snapshot.
    if (action.kind === "reset_avatar") return snapshotPicture(view) === false ? "already" : null;
    return action.kind === "reset_bio" && target.bio === "" ? "already" : null;
  }
  if (target.state === "deleted_by_author") return "deleted";
  // A post is withheld only by a withhold taken while deciding, and a target has one open case: by this case's own, which
  // a final decision that closes the case ends.
  const level = closes && target.level === "withheld" ? "visible" : target.level;
  if (action.kind === "withhold") return level !== null && level !== "visible" ? "already" : null;
  if (action.kind === "remove") return level === "removed" ? "already" : null;
  // An image measure: the post is not shown, or a measure in force of this case already holds the image back at least as far.
  if (level !== null && level !== "visible") return "already";
  const held = view.decisions.flatMap((decided) => decided.actions).filter((held) => held.inForce && !ending.has(held.id) && (held.kind === "seal_media" || held.mediaId === action.mediaId));
  const strong = held.some((measure) => measure.kind === "seal_media" || measure.kind === "remove_media");
  return strong || (action.kind === "withhold_media" && held.some((measure) => measure.kind === "withhold_media")) ? "already" : null;
}

/**
 * The targets whose measures a correction or a review lifts one by one, each with its own reversal (3c's). A strike falls
 * only with its whole finding: the console adds its overruling to a full reversal (overruleOf) and never offers it alone.
 * A retirement is given back with its own reversal (Task 2, 8.7), (Task 3) a suspension or a termination is lifted with
 * lift_suspension, and (Task 5) a warning about reporting or a restriction of it with lift_reporting: the first two share
 * the target `account` with the strike, so they are named by kind, and the reporting measures with them.
 */
// 2d Task 4: the profile picture's reset is lifted with its own reversal, as a field's.
const ONE_BY_ONE: readonly MeasureTarget[] = ["post", "image", "images", "display_name", "bio", "avatar", "handle"];
const ONE_BY_ONE_KINDS: readonly ActionKind[] = ["suspend", "terminate", "warn_reporting", "restrict_reporting"];

/** Whether a decision's action is a measure that a correction or a review lifts one by one. */
const liftsOneByOne = (action: { kind: ActionKind }): boolean =>
  MEASURES[action.kind].lifts === null && (ONE_BY_ONE.includes(MEASURES[action.kind].target) || ONE_BY_ONE_KINDS.includes(action.kind));

/** The strike a decision gave that stands (no overruling reversed it): what a full reversal of that decision overrules. */
export const standingStrikeOf = (decision: CaseDecision): CaseDecisionAction | undefined => decision.actions.find((action) => action.kind === "strike" && action.inForce);

/** The overruling a reversal of a decision carries: one when it reverses the decision whole and the decision's strike stands. */
function overruleOf(decision: CaseDecision | undefined, reversesWhole: boolean): DecisionActionParams[] {
  return decision && reversesWhole && standingStrikeOf(decision) ? [{ kind: "overrule", mediaId: null }] : [];
}

/**
 * The strike line under "Restrict" (3e design, section 8.2), by its key in STANDING_WORDS.strike, or null where the page
 * shows none: on an account case, and for an outcome that restricts nothing. It is not a choice: "due" is exactly when the
 * console signs a strike, and the database refuses any other list (strike_mismatch). A decision answers a report of child
 * sexual abuse material when it considers an unanswered suspect item, as a final decision considers every one.
 */
export type StrikeLine = "due" | "interim" | "law" | "r2" | "already" | "before";
export function strikeLine(view: CaseView, draft: CaseDraft): StrikeLine | null {
  if (view.strikeDue === null || (draft.kind !== "interim" && draft.kind !== "final") || draft.outcome !== "restricted") return null;
  if (draft.kind === "interim") return "interim";
  if (draft.ground === "illegal") return "law";
  if (draft.ruleId === "R2" || suspectOpen(view).length > 0) return "r2";
  if (view.strikeDue.due) return "due";
  return view.strikeDue.why === "already_struck" ? "already" : "before";
}
```
