}

/**
 * 2d (design, section 5.5.2): the earliest time a moderation entry of Activity may have, `days` before the database's
 * clock, to the microsecond: one read of the clock for every source of a page.
 */
export async function activitySince(q: Runner, days: number): Promise<string> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ since: string }>(q, sql`select to_char((now() - make_interval(days => ${days}::int)) at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as since`);
  return row!.since;
}

/**
 * 2d (design, sections 5.5.2 and 6.5): the account's lost images whose notice 3d's dispatch handled, from the told-only
 * function lost_told_for (the quarantine stays closed to the API's role): each image with its post, that post's time and
 * the loss's time to the microsecond, lost at or after `since` and at or before `through` when given, newest first, at
 * most the function's 100. Its p_before is strict and files lost together share a time, so it is asked from one
 * microsecond after `through`: the caller drops what it already listed at that time.
 */
export async function activityLost(q: Runner, accountId: string, through: string | null, since: string): Promise<{ mediaId: string; postId: string; postCreatedAt: string; at: string }[]> {
  const found = await rows<{ media_id: string; post_id: string; post_created_at: string; lost_at: string }>(
    q,
    sql`select l.media_id, l.post_id, ${iso("l.post_created_at")} as post_created_at, to_char(l.lost_at at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as lost_at
          from public.lost_told_for(${accountId}::uuid, ${through === null ? sql`'infinity'::timestamptz` : sql`${through}::timestamptz + interval '1 microsecond'`}, 100) l
         where l.lost_at >= ${since}::timestamptz`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({ mediaId: row.media_id, postId: row.post_id, postCreatedAt: row.post_created_at, at: row.lost_at }));
}

/**
 * The UTC day on which the last measure of decision `d` was lifted, for a final decision that restricted and of which
 * nothing is in force any more. Null while any of its measures stands, and for every other decision: a decision taken
 * while deciding ends with its case, without a reversal.
 */
const reversedOn = sql`case when d.kind = 'final' and d.outcome = 'restricted'
                  and exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind in ${MEASURES})
                  and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind in ${MEASURES}
                                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id))
             then (select ${day("max(r.created_at)")} from decision_actions a join decision_actions r on r.reverses_action_id = a.id where a.decision_id = d.id) end`;

/**
 * The strike decision `d` gave (3e design, section 10.2), read fresh: its end of counting, when it was overruled, and
 * whether it counts now, ran out or was overruled; all null for a decision without one.
 */
const strikeColumns = sql`(select ${iso("a.ends_at")} from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike') as strike_until,
               (select ${iso("r.created_at")} from decision_actions a join decision_actions r on r.reverses_action_id = a.id
                 where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike') as strike_overruled_at,
               (select case when exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id) then 'overruled'
                            when a.ends_at <= clock_timestamp() then 'expired' else 'counts' end
                  from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'strike') as strike_state`;

/**
 * The cases about an account: the account's own, and those about the posts it wrote. A post keeps its author through its
 * deletion and the account's purge, so a decision stays with the account it was about.
 */
const casesAbout = (accountId: string) => sql`(
    select c.id, c.target_type, c.target_id from cases c where c.target_type = 'account' and c.target_id = ${accountId}::uuid
    union all
    select c.id, c.target_type, c.target_id from cases c join posts p on p.id = c.target_id where c.target_type = 'post' and p.author_id = ${accountId}::uuid
  )`;

/**
 * The time by which the author's list places decision `d` (3f's review, people9; section 9.3): an order decision's row
 * shows, and sorts by, when its author was told, which for a notice released after a hold is weeks after the disabling;
 * every other decision by its own time. The list reads only told decisions, so informed_at is set.
 */
const listedAt = sql.raw(`case when d.kind::text = 'order' then d.informed_at else d.decided_at end`);

/** One decision as the author's list shows it. */
export interface AuthorDecisionRow {
  id: string;
  kind: "interim" | "final" | "order" | "review" | "correction";
  outcome: string;
  decidedOn: string;
  /** 3f's review (people9): for an order decision, the UTC day its author was told, which its row shows; null otherwise. */
  toldOn: string | null;
  /** The time the list places the decision by (listedAt) to the microsecond, as text: what the next page starts after. */
  sortAt: string;
  post: { id: string; createdAt: string } | null;
  actions: ActionKind[];
  endedInterim: boolean;
  ruleId: string | null;
  legal: boolean;
  appealUntil: string | null;
  reversedOn: string | null;
  /** Where the author's appeal of the decision stands: pending, or its result; null when they filed none. */
  appeal: "pending" | "kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed" | null;
  /** The strike the decision gave: until when it counts and when it was overruled; null for a decision without one. */
  strike: { countsUntil: string; overruledAt: string | null } | null;
  /** 3e Task 5: the days of the decision's restriction of reporting; null for a decision without one. */
  reportingDays: number | null;
  /** 3e Task 5: the kinds of the measures whose basis a reversal of this decision broke, as its statement's endedStanding lists them. */
  endedStanding: ("suspend" | "terminate" | "restrict_reporting")[];
  /** 3e's review (people7): the decision's suspension or termination, which its row names with its days and kind; null for none. */
  standingMeasure: { kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; days: number | null; announced: boolean } | null;
  /** 3e's review (people7): what the decision's lift lifted, and whether it was a withdrawal for another measure; null for none. */
  liftedStanding: { kind: "suspend" | "terminate"; replaced: boolean } | null;
  /** 3f: an order decision, disabled or removed by its measure, or the correction that reinstates after one (lifted): its row names no rule; null otherwise. */
  order: "disabled" | "removed" | "lifted" | null;
  /** 3d Task 6: the decision has no decider, a program took it ([auto.chip]). */
  byProgram: boolean;
}

/**
 * The decisions about this account that its author was told of (toldToAuthor), newest first, after the cursor when one
 * is given. A decision the author was not told of is in no page.
 */
export async function authorDecisions(q: Runner, accountId: string, after: { at: string; id: string } | null, limit: number): Promise<AuthorDecisionRow[]> {
  const found = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select d.id, d.kind, d.outcome, ${day("d.decided_at")} as decided_on,
               case when d.kind::text = 'order' then ${day("d.informed_at")} end as told_on,
               to_char(${listedAt} at time zone 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS.US"Z"') as sort_at,
               c.target_type, c.target_id,
               (select ${iso("p.created_at")} from posts p where c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id) as post_created_at,
               coalesce((select array_agg(a.kind::text order by a.kind, a.media_id) from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id), '{}') as actions,
               d.ended_interim, d.rule_id, d.ground is not distinct from 'illegal' as legal,
               ${appealUntil} as appeal_until, ${reversedOn} as reversed_on,
               (select coalesce(ap.result::text, 'pending') from appeals ap where ap.decision_id = d.id) as appeal,
               ${strikeColumns},
               (select a.days from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'restrict_reporting') as reporting_days,
               (select json_build_object('kind', a.kind::text, 'days', a.days, 'announced', a.announced) from decision_actions a
                 where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate')) as standing_measure,
               (select json_build_object('kind', l.kind::text, 'replaced', coalesce(x.replaced, false)) from decision_actions x join decision_actions l on l.id = x.reverses_action_id
                 where x.decision_id = d.id and x.kind = 'lift_suspension') as lifted_standing,
               -- The measures whose basis this review or correction broke, as the statement's endedStanding reads them.
               coalesce((select array_agg(m.kind::text order by m.created_at, m.id) from decision_actions m
                          where d.kind in ('review', 'correction') and m.kind in ('suspend', 'terminate', 'restrict_reporting') and d.reviews_decision_id = any(m.rests_on)
                            and public.standing_basis_broken_at(m.id) = d.decided_at
                            and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions x where x.reverses_action_id = m.id and x.created_at < d.decided_at)), '{}') as ended_standing,
               case when d.kind::text = 'order'
                    then case when coalesce((select a.withhold_author from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind::text = 'disable_by_order' limit 1), true) then 'disabled' else 'removed' end
                    when exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind::text = 'reinstate_by_order') then 'lifted' end as about_order,
               d.decided_by is null as by_program
          from ${casesAbout(accountId)} c join decisions d on d.case_id = c.id
         where ${toldToAuthor("d")}
           ${after === null ? sql`` : sql`and (${listedAt}, d.id) < (${after.at}::timestamptz, ${after.id}::uuid)`}
         order by ${listedAt} desc, d.id desc limit ${limit}::int`,
  );
  return found.map((row) => ({
    id: row.id as string,
    kind: row.kind as AuthorDecisionRow["kind"],
    outcome: row.outcome as string,
    decidedOn: row.decided_on as string,
    toldOn: row.told_on as string | null,
    sortAt: row.sort_at as string,
    post: row.target_type === "post" && row.post_created_at !== null ? { id: row.target_id as string, createdAt: row.post_created_at as string } : null,
    actions: row.actions as ActionKind[],
    endedInterim: row.ended_interim as boolean,
    ruleId: row.rule_id as string | null,
    legal: row.legal as boolean,
    appealUntil: row.appeal_until as string | null,
    reversedOn: row.reversed_on as string | null,
    appeal: row.appeal as AuthorDecisionRow["appeal"],
    strike: row.strike_until === null ? null : { countsUntil: row.strike_until as string, overruledAt: row.strike_overruled_at as string | null },
    reportingDays: row.reporting_days as number | null,
    endedStanding: row.ended_standing as AuthorDecisionRow["endedStanding"],
    standingMeasure: row.standing_measure as AuthorDecisionRow["standingMeasure"],
    liftedStanding: row.lifted_standing as AuthorDecisionRow["liftedStanding"],
    order: (row.about_order as AuthorDecisionRow["order"]) ?? null,
    byProgram: row.by_program as boolean,
  }));
}

/**
 * 3d Task 6 (design, sections 7.10 and 10.2): where "Ask for a person" stands on a decision, read fresh: null for a decision
 * with a decider; for a program's, `open` while a measure of it is in force and no request exists, `asked` with the text
 * and its time while the measure stays in force, and `decided` once no measure of it is in force, naming the person's
 * decision that ended it: the correction or review whose row lifted its measure, else the case's first final decision
 * after it, which ended it by 3c's derivation. Only decisions the author was told of are named. Nothing stores "answered".
 */
export async function askPersonOf(q: Runner, decisionId: string): Promise<AskPerson | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<{ program: boolean; in_force: boolean; text: string | null; created_at: string | null; ender_id: string | null; ender_at: string | null }>(
    q,
    sql`select d.decided_by is null as program,
               exists (select 1 from measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = d.id) as in_force,
               o.text, ${iso("o.created_at")} as created_at, e.id as ender_id, ${iso("e.decided_at")} as ender_at
          from decisions d
          left join automated_objections o on o.decision_id = d.id
          left join lateral (
            select x.id, x.decided_at from decisions x
             where ${toldToAuthor("x")}
               and (x.id in (select r.decision_id from decision_actions a join decision_actions r on r.reverses_action_id = a.id where a.decision_id = d.id)
                    or (x.case_id = d.case_id and x.kind = 'final' and x.decided_at >= d.decided_at))
             order by x.decided_at, x.id limit 1) e on true
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid`,
  );
  if (!row || !row.program) return null;
  if (row.in_force) return row.created_at === null ? { state: "open" } : { state: "asked", text: row.text ?? "", createdAt: row.created_at };
  if (row.ender_id === null || row.ender_at === null) return null;
  return { state: "decided", decisionId: row.ender_id, decidedAt: row.ender_at };
}

/**
 * The author's appeal of a decision. While it is pending: whether anyone at korbat may review it now, as the database
 * answers it in one word that names nobody, and whether its review is an admin's. Once answered: its result, the UTC day
 * and the decision that answered it.
 */
export interface AuthorAppealFacts {
  filedAt: string;
  reviewer: "available" | "none_single_staff" | "none_eligible" | null;
  needsAdmin: boolean;
  result: "kept" | "partly_reversed" | "reversed" | null;
  answeredOn: string | null;
  answeredBy: string | null;
}

/** What the author's view of one decision adds to its statement: where its appeal stands, and its snapshot with what decides whether and how it is shown. */
export interface AuthorDecisionFacts {
  targetType: "post" | "account";
  targetId: string;
  appealUntil: string | null;
  reversedOn: string | null;
  /** Null when the author filed no appeal of this decision. */
  appeal: AuthorAppealFacts | null;
  /** The database's one predicate by which a snapshot's content is withheld wherever it would be shown. */
  withheld: boolean;
  erased: boolean;
  /** The UTC day the snapshot was erased; null while it is kept. */
  erasedOn: string | null;
  /** A decision about the same post or account carries an R4 redaction. */
  redacted: boolean;
  body: string | null;
  images: { id: string; alt: string | null; width: number; height: number }[];
  handle: string;
  displayName: string | null;
  bio: string | null;
  /** For a decision about a post: whether its author deleted it, whether its content was erased, and whether a seal in force lists it. */
  postDeleted: boolean;
  postErased: boolean;
  sealed: boolean;
  /** The strike the decision gave, read fresh: until when it counts, whether it still does, and when it was overruled. */
  strike: DecisionStrike | null;
  /** 3f: an order decision whose measure is in force, whose post the notice's screen never shows (section 10.4). */
  orderInForce: boolean;
  /**
   * 3f's review (access4): a decision about a post that is disabled for an order now, told after the post was first
   * disabled (a decision held with the notice and released with it): its screen shows the post no more than the
   * notice's does. A decision told before the order keeps its content, as row 47 of the design says.
   */
  toldWhileDisabled: boolean;
}

/**
 * One decision for the account it is about, or null: when no decision has the id, when it is about someone else, and when
 * its author was not told of it, so that no such decision opens by its id. A post's images are sealed exactly while a
 * seal in force lists the post, which is how the database derives their state too; this module never reads an image row.
 */
export async function authorDecision(q: Runner, accountId: string, decisionId: string): Promise<AuthorDecisionFacts | null> {
  const [row] = await rows<Record<string, unknown>>(
    q,
    sql`select c.target_type, c.target_id, ${appealUntil} as appeal_until, ${reversedOn} as reversed_on,
               ap.id as appeal_id, ${iso("ap.filed_at")} as appeal_filed_at, public.appeal_reviewer_state(ap.id) as appeal_reviewer,
               public.review_needs_admin(d.id) as appeal_needs_admin, ap.result as appeal_result, ${day("ap.answered_at")} as appeal_answered_on,
               ap.answered_by as appeal_answered_by,
               public.snapshot_withheld(d.snapshot_id) as withheld, s.erased_at is not null as erased, ${day("s.erased_at")} as erased_on,
               exists (select 1 from decisions r join cases rc on rc.id = r.case_id
                        where rc.target_type = c.target_type and rc.target_id = c.target_id and r.redacted_at is not null) as redacted,
               s.body, s.media::text as media, coalesce(s.handle, s.author_handle) as handle, s.display_name, s.bio,
               coalesce(p.state = 'deleted_by_author', false) as post_deleted, coalesce(p.erased_at is not null, false) as post_erased,
               (c.target_type = 'post' and exists (select 1 from seal_posts sp join measures_in_force m on m.id = sp.action_id where sp.post_id = c.target_id)) as sealed,
               ${strikeColumns},
               (d.kind::text = 'order' and exists (select 1 from measures_in_force m where m.decision_id = d.id)) as order_in_force,
               coalesce(p.state::text = 'disabled'
                        and d.informed_at > (select min(i.disabled_at) from legal_order_items i where i.post_id = p.id), false) as told_while_disabled
          from decisions d
          join cases c on c.id = d.case_id
          join evidence_snapshots s on s.id = d.snapshot_id
          left join posts p on c.target_type = 'post' and p.id = c.target_id
          left join appeals ap on ap.decision_id = d.id
         where d.id = ${decisionId}::uuid and ${toldToAuthor("d")}
           and case when c.target_type = 'post' then p.author_id = ${accountId}::uuid else c.target_id = ${accountId}::uuid end`,
  );
  if (!row) return null;
  return {
    targetType: row.target_type as "post" | "account",
    targetId: row.target_id as string,
    appealUntil: row.appeal_until as string | null,
    reversedOn: row.reversed_on as string | null,
    appeal:
      row.appeal_id === null
        ? null
        : {
            filedAt: row.appeal_filed_at as string,
            reviewer: row.appeal_reviewer as AuthorAppealFacts["reviewer"],
            needsAdmin: row.appeal_needs_admin as boolean,
            result: row.appeal_result as AuthorAppealFacts["result"],
            answeredOn: row.appeal_answered_on as string | null,
            answeredBy: row.appeal_answered_by as string | null,
          },
    withheld: row.withheld as boolean,
    erased: row.erased as boolean,
    erasedOn: row.erased_on as string | null,
    redacted: row.redacted as boolean,
    body: row.body as string | null,
    images: row.media === null ? [] : (JSON.parse(row.media as string) as AuthorDecisionFacts["images"]),
    handle: row.handle as string,
    displayName: row.display_name as string | null,
    bio: row.bio as string | null,
    postDeleted: row.post_deleted as boolean,
    postErased: row.post_erased as boolean,
    sealed: row.sealed as boolean,
    strike:
      row.strike_until === null
        ? null
        : { countsUntil: row.strike_until as string, state: row.strike_state as DecisionStrike["state"], overruledAt: row.strike_overruled_at as string | null },
    orderInForce: row.order_in_force as boolean,
    toldWhileDisabled: row.told_while_disabled as boolean,
  };
}

/**
 * The decision behind the state of each of these posts that the account wrote and that is withheld or removed (3c design,
 * section 5): the decision of the strongest post measure in force, a removal (3f: or a disabling for an order, which
 * reaches this read only as the level removed, a DSA order that does not withhold) before a withhold and the newest
 * first; or,
 * for a post that is removed only because its content was erased, with no post measure in force, the newest decision
 * whose R4 redaction it was. A post of someone else, and one that is visible, is not in the answer.
 */
export async function chipFacts(q: Runner, accountId: string, postIds: readonly string[]): Promise<Map<string, PostModeration>> {
  const facts = new Map<string, PostModeration>();
  if (postIds.length === 0) return facts;
  const found = await rows<{ post_id: string; decision_id: string; rule_id: string | null; legal: boolean; interim: boolean; strike_until: string | null; is_order: boolean }>(
    q,
    sql`select p.id as post_id, f.decision_id, f.rule_id, f.legal, f.interim,
               exists (select 1 from decisions o where o.id = f.decision_id and o.kind::text = 'order') as is_order,
               -- 3e: the strike of the chip's decision while it stands and still counts.
               (select ${iso("a.ends_at")} from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = f.decision_id and a.kind = 'strike' and a.ends_at > clock_timestamp()
                   and not exists (select 1 from decision_actions r where r.reverses_action_id = a.id)) as strike_until
          from posts p
          cross join lateral (
            (select d.id as decision_id, d.rule_id, d.ground is not distinct from 'illegal' as legal, d.kind = 'interim' as interim, 0 as source,
                    (m.kind::text in ('remove', 'disable_by_order')) as removes, d.decided_at
               from measures_in_force m join decisions d on d.id = m.decision_id
              where m.post_id = p.id and m.kind::text in ('withhold', 'remove', 'disable_by_order') and ${toldToAuthor("d")})
            union all
            (select d.id, d.rule_id, d.ground is not distinct from 'illegal', false, 1, true, d.redacted_at
               from cases c join decisions d on d.case_id = c.id
              where c.target_type = 'post' and c.target_id = p.id and p.erased_at is not null and d.redacted_at is not null and ${toldToAuthor("d")}
                and exists (select 1 from decision_actions a where a.decision_id = d.id and a.kind = 'remove'))
            order by source, removes desc, decided_at desc, decision_id desc
            limit 1
          ) f
         where p.id = any(${`{${postIds.join(",")}}`}::uuid[]) and p.author_id = ${accountId}::uuid and p.moderation_level in ('withheld', 'removed')`,
  );
  for (const row of found) {
    facts.set(row.post_id, { decisionId: row.decision_id, ruleId: row.rule_id as RuleId | null, legal: row.legal, interim: row.interim, strikeUntil: row.strike_until, ...(row.is_order ? { order: true } : {}) });
  }
  return facts;
}

import { sendStatement } from "./statement";

/**
 * The automated step, its sweep and "Ask for a person" (3d design, sections 2 rows 14 to 25, 5 "The lock order", 6.6,
 * 7.9, 7.10 and 7.14; Task 6). A signal is a fact about one image on a post: a score at or over the threshold, or (Task 7)
 * a match record. The step turns it into a program's finding and, where the setting allows it, into one
 * protective measure, a decision without a decider that is always interim, holds exactly that measure, and stands only
 * with the system's audit row and its signal (decision_holds at commit). It never runs inside the transaction that made
 * the post or stored the signal's fact: it is a deciding transaction of its own, which takes the author's profile first,
 * as every deciding transaction does. So an image can be public for seconds before a measure.
 *
 * The program never has the last word: its measure lasts until a person decides the case or lifts it, its author is told
 * at once and can ask for a person, and four limits (counted by rule, and two on what waits for a person) stop it from
 * taking new measures, never from opening findings, when nobody answers. No score is ever logged, printed or answered.
 */

/** How often the step's transaction is run again after a deadlock, a lock timeout or a case that closed under it, as an intake is. */
const RETRIES = 3;
/** The longest one run of the step waits for a lock, as an intake waits. */
const LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS = 10_000;

/** The sweep's name: its lock is `job:automated-sweep`. A round a minute after the last one ended (7.14). */
export const AUTOMATED_SWEEP_JOB = "automated-sweep";
export const AUTOMATED_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS = 60_000;

/** The alert automation_capped goes at most once an hour, under this key of the limit store (7.9 step 3). */
export const CAPPED_ALERT_KEY = "automation-capped";
export const CAPPED_ALERT_WINDOW_MS = 60 * 60_000;
/** The alert automated_objection goes at most once in 15 minutes (7.10 step 3). */
export const OBJECTION_ALERT_KEY = "automated-objection";
export const OBJECTION_ALERT_WINDOW_MS = 15 * 60_000;

/**
 * The threshold a score is compared with, and its version, as R1_CLASSIFIER has it (section 5, "The threshold while only
 * the test adapter exists"): none while the scorer is off; the test scorer's own 0.5 under version 0 under `test`; and
 * the owner's measured threshold for a real classifier, which no build of 3d carries, and which opens nothing while it
 * is null. Null means that no score opens anything.
 */
export function r1Threshold(config: Pick<ModerationDeps["config"], "R1_CLASSIFIER">): { threshold: number; thresholdVersion: number } | null {
  if (config.R1_CLASSIFIER === "off") return null;
  if (config.R1_CLASSIFIER === "test") return { threshold: R1_TEST_THRESHOLD.threshold, thresholdVersion: R1_TEST_THRESHOLD.thresholdVersion };
  return AUTOMATION_RULES.r1Threshold === null ? null : { threshold: AUTOMATION_RULES.r1Threshold, thresholdVersion: AUTOMATION_RULES.r1ThresholdVersion };
}

/** What one run of the step did: how it handled the signal ("already" when another run had), and the finding's case and the decision it made, if any. */
export interface StepOutcome {
  handled: SignalHandled | "already";
  caseId: string | null;
  decisionId: string | null;
  /** The limit a refused measure met, for the alert automation_capped. */
  limit: CapLimit | null;
  /** 3d Task 7: the finding cites R2, so the urgent alert goes out after the commit. */
  urgent?: boolean;
}

/** The ground of a program's finding under R1: rule R1 with its default category, no sender, no text (7.9 step 2.2). */
const R1_GROUND: IntakeGround = {
  kind: "automated",
  channel: "system",
  reporterId: null,
  findingBy: null,
  contactId: null,
  ruleId: "R1",
  allegesIllegal: false,
  csam: false,
  category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1,
  categoryKeyword: null,
  citedLaw: null,
  explanation: null,
  bonaFide: false,
  automatedProcessing: true,
};

/**
 * 3d Task 7 (design, sections 6.6, 6.7 and 7.9 step 2.2): the ground of a program's finding on a match. A match of a class
 * the source itself lists as child sexual abuse material, acting or not, cites R2 with its default category: lane 0, and
 * suspect by 3c's trigger, so the post is frozen from the commit. A match of any other class cites no rule: the category
 * the Transparency Database gives a notice that names none, lane 2, not suspect, freezing nothing and alerting nobody.
 */
function matchGround(listed: boolean): IntakeGround {
  return listed
    ? { ...R1_GROUND, ruleId: "R2", category: RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R2 }
    : { ...R1_GROUND, ruleId: null, category: "STATEMENT_CATEGORY_NOT_SPECIFIED_NOTICE" };
}

/** Thrown inside the step's transaction to end it with nothing written: another run handled the signal first. */
class AlreadyHandled extends Error {}

/**
 * The step for one signal (7.9 "The step"), in one transaction on the API's pool with a 10-second lock timeout, run again
 * up to three times on a deadlock, a lock timeout or a case that closed under it, as an intake is. The image's post and
 * its author are read before it: an attached image never moves to another post, and a post's author never changes. After
 * the commit, each in a try of its own: the author's statement when a measure was taken, and the alert automation_capped
 * when a limit refused one. Task 6 builds the step of a score; a match record's step is Task 7's.
 */
export async function automatedStep(deps: ModerationDeps, signalId: string): Promise<StepOutcome> {
  const signal = await signalOf(deps.apiDb, signalId);
  if (signal === null || signal.handledAt !== null) return { handled: "already", caseId: null, decisionId: null, limit: null };
  const postId = await imagePost(deps.apiDb, signal.mediaId);

  // changes, read before the transaction as an image's post is.
  const ownerId = postId === null ? await avatarOwner(deps.apiDb, signal.mediaId) : null;
  const authorId = postId === null ? ownerId : await deps.social.postAuthor(postId);
  let outcome: StepOutcome | null = null;
  for (let attempt = 0; outcome === null; attempt++) {
    try {
      outcome = await deps.apiDb.transaction((tx) => (ownerId !== null ? avatarStepIn(deps, tx, signal, ownerId) : stepIn(deps, tx, signal, postId, authorId)));
    } catch (err) {
      if (err instanceof AlreadyHandled) return { handled: "already", caseId: null, decisionId: null, limit: null };
      const retried = isDeadlock(err) || isLockNotAvailable(err) || isSerializationFailure(err) || isStartOver(err);
      if (!retried || attempt >= RETRIES) throw err;
    }
  }
  const done = outcome;
  if (done.decisionId !== null) {
    try {
      await sendStatement(deps, done.decisionId);
    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.warn({ err, decisionId: done.decisionId }, "moderation: a program's statement was not mailed; it stays pending for the dispatch job");
    }
  }
  if (done.handled === "capped") {
    try {

    } catch (err) {
      deps.log.error({ err }, "moderation: the staff accounts were not alerted that a program reached a limit");

  // no rule alerts nobody: it stands in the queue and is counted on the home screen.

/**

async function stepIn(deps: ModerationDeps, tx: DbTx, signal: SignalRow, postId: string | null, authorId: string | null): Promise<StepOutcome> {

  await joinSignal(tx, signal.id, item.id);
  // 3d Task 7 (review ruling 8): the record is marked handled and names the finding's case, in this transaction; the
  // guard automated_signals_guard has held the finding's rule to the record's class at the join above.
  if (record !== null) await deps.media.matchJoined(tx, record.id, item.caseId);
  const urgent = record !== null && record.listed;

  // The measure: under R1 with AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS on; under R2 with AUTOMATION_R2_ACTS on and only for an acting match,
  // listed and exact (a flag seals nothing, which decision_holds holds at commit whatever this says).
  const acts = record === null ? deps.config.AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS === "on" : deps.config.AUTOMATION_R2_ACTS === "on" && record.acting;
  if (!acts) {

    const decisionId = await tx.transaction((sp) => measureIn(deps, sp, { caseId: item.caseId!, postId, signalId: signal.id, mediaId: signal.mediaId, rule: record === null ? "R1" : "R2" }));
    return { handled: "measure", caseId: item.caseId, decisionId, limit: null, urgent };
  } catch (err) {
    const refusal = raisedMessage(err);
    if (refusal === "already_protected") {
      await signalHandled(tx, signal.id, "covered");
      return { handled: "covered", caseId: item.caseId, decisionId: null, limit: null, urgent };
    }
    if (refusal === "automation_capped") {
      const detail = raisedDetail(err);
      const limit = (CAP_LIMITS as readonly string[]).includes(detail ?? "") ? (detail as CapLimit) : null;
      await signalHandled(tx, signal.id, "capped");
      return { handled: "capped", caseId: item.caseId, decisionId: null, limit, urgent };
    }
    throw err;
  }
}

/**
 * 2d Task 4 (design, sections 7.6 and decision 15): the account branch of the step, for a signal on an avatar, in the
 * step's transaction:
 *   1. the owner's profile FOR NO KEY UPDATE, the first lock, then the signal again in a statement of its own (a handled one
 *      ends the run with nothing written), and a match's record as for a post's image;
 *   2. gone, handled `gone`, when the profile is deleted or the avatar is no longer its ready, unerased picture: the program
 *      judges only a picture someone may be shown;
 *   3. the finding, as for a post's image but about the account: its open case or a new one, one intake of the kind
 *      automated, one item about the account, the case's hold on its picture and the account's snapshot, which lists the
 *      picture by reference ("the avatar in its scope"); then the item on the signal;
 *   4. never a measure, whatever AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS says: no program takes a measure on an account. The signal is handled
 *      `finding`;
 *   5. while AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS is on and the signal is a score, R1's hold for review: avatar_review withholds the picture
 *      from everyone but its owner until a person answers the item.
 */
async function avatarStepIn(deps: ModerationDeps, tx: DbTx, signal: SignalRow, ownerId: string): Promise<StepOutcome> {
  await tx.execute(sql`select set_config('lock_timeout', ${`${LOCK_TIMEOUT_MS}ms`}::text, true)`);
  const locked = await deps.social.lockAccounts(tx, [ownerId], "no key update");
  const current = await signalOf(tx, signal.id);
  if (current === null || current.handledAt !== null) throw new AlreadyHandled();
  const record = signal.kind === "known_match" && signal.matchId !== null ? await deps.media.matchRecord(tx, signal.matchId) : null;
  if (signal.kind === "known_match" && (record === null || record.erased)) throw new AlreadyHandled();

  // Read after the profile's lock, which setAvatar, removeAvatar and the purge take too.
  const pictured = await deps.media.signals(tx, { avatarId: signal.mediaId, ownerId });
  const handle = await accountHandle(tx, ownerId);
  if (locked.length !== 1 || locked[0]!.deleted || pictured.length === 0 || handle === null) {
    await signalHandled(tx, signal.id, "gone");
    if (record !== null) await deps.media.matchJoined(tx, record.id, null);
    return { handled: "gone", caseId: null, decisionId: null, limit: null };
  }

  const ground = record === null ? R1_GROUND : matchGround(record.listed);
  const recorded = await recordIntakeIn(deps, tx, { ground, live: [{ type: "account", id: ownerId, position: 1, namedHandle: handle }] });
  const item = recorded.items[0];
  if (item === undefined || item.caseId === null) throw new Error("a program's finding about an account was stored without a case");
  await joinSignal(tx, signal.id, item.id);
  if (record !== null) await deps.media.matchJoined(tx, record.id, item.caseId);
  await signalHandled(tx, signal.id, "finding");
  if (record === null && deps.config.AUTOMATION_R1_ACTS === "on") {
    await tx.execute(sql`select public.avatar_review(${signal.mediaId}::uuid, ${item.id}::uuid)`);
  }
  return { handled: "finding", caseId: item.caseId, decisionId: null, limit: null, urgent: record !== null && record.listed };
}

/** The account's handle now, as a finding names it, or null when there is no profile. */
async function accountHandle(tx: DbTx, accountId: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const [row] = await tx.execute<{ handle: string }>(sql`select handle from public.profiles where id = ${accountId}::uuid`);
  return row?.handle ?? null;
}

/** What a program's measure is taken on: the finding's case, its post, the signal and the signal's image. */
export interface MeasureInput {
  caseId: string;
  postId: string;
  signalId: string;
  mediaId: string;
  /** 3d Task 7: R2 seals the post's images on a match; R1 (the default) withholds the signal's image on a score. */
  rule?: "R1" | "R2";
}

/**
 * The params of a program's withhold, as the system's audit row carries them (AutomatedDecidedParams, 10.4): the values
 * every program's decision fixes, with the case's version as this transaction reads it after the item joined, the
 * snapshot and the current rulebook and redress versions.
 */
export function automatedParams(input: { stateVersion: number; snapshot: { id: string; digest: string }; mediaId: string; rule?: "R1" | "R2" }): AutomatedDecidedParams {
  const r2 = input.rule === "R2";
  return AutomatedDecidedParams.parse({
    kind: "interim",
    stateVersion: input.stateVersion,
    throughSeq: 0,
    reviewsDecisionId: null,
    snapshotId: input.snapshot.id,
    snapshotDigest: input.snapshot.digest,
    outcome: "restricted",
    ground: "incompatible",
    ruleId: r2 ? "R2" : "R1",
    rulesVersion: RULES_VERSION,
    redressVersion: REDRESS_VERSION,
    category: r2 ? RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R2 : RULE_DEFAULT_CATEGORY.R1,
    categoryKeyword: null,
    // 3d Task 7: a seal covers every image of the post (3c 6.2), so it names none.
    actions: [r2 ? { kind: "seal_media", mediaId: null } : { kind: "withhold_media", mediaId: input.mediaId }],
    factsDigest: null,
    reasonDigest: null,
    legalReferenceDigest: null,
    unfounded: [],
    replaced: false,
  });
}

/**
 * Step 2.4, inside the step's savepoint: the measure of a score. The snapshot of the post as it stands when the case's
 * newest differs (the snapshot route's own run); the decision's row without a decider; its one ledger row; the signal
 * handled `measure` with its decision; and last the system's plain audit row automated_decided on the case, naming the
 * decision, its one signal and the case's target, with the params decision_holds compares. Answers the decision's id.
 */
export async function measureIn(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "social" | "media">, tx: DbTx, input: MeasureInput): Promise<string> {
  const row = await caseById(tx, input.caseId);
  if (row === null) throw new Error("a program's finding names a case that does not exist");
  const snapshot = await snapshotIn(deps, tx, row);
  // The case's version as this transaction reads it after the item joined and the snapshot: what decisions_record compares.
  const stateVersion = (await caseById(tx, input.caseId))!.stateVersion;
  const params = automatedParams({ stateVersion, snapshot, mediaId: input.mediaId, rule: input.rule ?? "R1" });
  const decisionId = randomUUID();
  await insertSystemDecision(tx, { id: decisionId, caseId: input.caseId, params });
  await insertAction(tx, decisionId, params.actions[0]);
  await signalHandled(tx, input.signalId, "measure", decisionId);
  await appendAuditRow(tx, {
    actorId: SYSTEM_ACTOR_ID,
    action: "automated_decided",
    targetType: "case",
    targetId: input.caseId,
    requestId: null,
    metadata: { params, decisionId, signalId: input.signalId, target: { type: "post", id: input.postId } },
  });
  return decisionId;
}

/** The alert automation_capped (7.9 step 3; W.7): the limit met as its fact (1), and the findings that stand without a measure since. */
async function alertCapped(deps: ModerationDeps, limit: CapLimit | null): Promise<void> {
  const count = await cappedSinceLastMeasure(deps.apiDb);
  const fact = limit === null ? {} : { [`limit${limit.charAt(0).toUpperCase()}${limit.slice(1)}`]: 1 };
  await staffAlert(deps, CAPPED_ALERT_KEY, CAPPED_ALERT_WINDOW_MS, { template: "automation_capped", facts: { at: deps.now().toISOString(), count, ...fact } });
}

/**
 * A score at or over the threshold of an image on a post becomes its signal and its step (7.9 step 1, then step 2). A
 * score under it, or one while no threshold applies, does nothing. An image that has its signal already starts nothing:
 * the step of that signal runs or ran, and the sweep finds it if it failed.
 */
export async function scoreSignal(deps: ModerationDeps, image: { mediaId: string; score: number | null }): Promise<StepOutcome | null> {
  const threshold = r1Threshold(deps.config);
  if (threshold === null || image.score === null || image.score < threshold.threshold) return null;
  const signalId = await insertScoreSignal(deps.apiDb, { mediaId: image.mediaId, score: image.score, thresholdVersion: threshold.thresholdVersion });
  return signalId === null ? null : automatedStep(deps, signalId);
}

/**
 * ModerationForSocial.imagesPublished (7.9, "What starts it"): createPost calls it after its commit when the post has
 * images. It starts its task on the module's background and returns at once, so createPost never waits for a deciding
 * transaction; with the scorer off it starts nothing. The task reads the post's images' scores, which the media module
 * stored when the worker's result was taken in, and runs the step of each at or over the threshold, one after the other.
 */
export function imagesPublished(deps: ModerationDeps, postId: string): void {
  const scoring = r1Threshold(deps.config) !== null;
  const matching = deps.config.MEDIA_MATCH !== "off";
  if (!scoring && !matching) return;
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    for (const image of await deps.media.signals(deps.apiDb, postId)) {
      if (scoring) await scoreSignal(deps, image);
      // 3d Task 7 (7.9, "What starts it"): an image accepted with a flag as an upload, now posted: its record's step.
      if (matching && image.match !== null && !image.match.handled) await matchSignal(deps, { mediaId: image.mediaId, matchId: image.match.id });
    }
  });
}

/**
 * 2d Task 4 (design, section 7.6): ModerationForSocial.avatarSet. setAvatar calls it after its commit. On the module's
 * background, unwaited for, it reads the avatar's score and match record through the media module (signals' avatar
 * form), and a score at or over the threshold, or a match the program is not done with, becomes its signal and its step,
 * which takes the account branch. With the scorer and the matcher off it starts nothing. Setting the same picture again
 * starts no second step: an image has one signal of a kind.
 */
export function avatarSet(deps: ModerationDeps, accountId: string, mediaId: string): void {
  const scoring = r1Threshold(deps.config) !== null;
  const matching = deps.config.MEDIA_MATCH !== "off";
  if (!scoring && !matching) return;
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    for (const image of await deps.media.signals(deps.apiDb, { avatarId: mediaId, ownerId: accountId })) {
      if (scoring) await scoreSignal(deps, image);
      if (matching && image.match !== null && !image.match.handled) await matchSignal(deps, { mediaId: image.mediaId, matchId: image.match.id });
    }
  });
}

/**
 * 3d Task 7 (7.9 step 1, then step 2): a match record of an image on a post becomes its signal and its step. An image that
 * has its match signal already (handled, or a second record of the same image) starts nothing; its record is marked
 * handled in a statement of its own, so the sweep does not find it again. 3d review H1: only a record that no signal
 * names: when the existing signal names this very record, its step (in flight, failed, or another entry's) is the one
 * that marks it, with its case, and a mark here ended that step as "already" for good.
 */
export async function matchSignal(deps: ModerationDeps, image: { mediaId: string; matchId: string }): Promise<StepOutcome | null> {
  const signalId = await insertMatchSignal(deps.apiDb, image);
  if (signalId === null) {
    await deps.apiDb.transaction((tx) => deps.media.matchPassed(tx, image.matchId));
    return null;
  }
  return automatedStep(deps, signalId);
}

/** What one round of the sweep did. */
export interface SweepReport {
  /** Signals a crash or a failed step had left unhandled, run again. */
  retried: number;
  /** Images with a score at or over the threshold and no signal, given one. */
  signalled: number;
  /** Steps that failed again, which the next round tries while the signal is younger than SWEEP_HOURS. */
  failed: number;
  /** Whether the round wrote the daily alert automated_waiting. */
  waiting: boolean;
}

/**
 * One round of the job automated-sweep (7.9, 7.14): at most SWEEP_BATCH signals, then at most SWEEP_BATCH images (3d review
 * H1: each read its own batch), each read only while its tool's
 * adapter is not off, so no program opens a finding on a day on which /rules prints its tool as off. First the signals
 * between one minute and SWEEP_HOURS old that no step handled (the module's own read of automated_signals); then, through
 * MediaForCases.unsignalled, the images of posts of the last SWEEP_HOURS whose score is at or over the threshold and that
 * no signal names. Each step in a try of its own. Then the daily alert automated_waiting, written once in 24 hours while a
 * request for a person has waited longer than the published target.
 */
export async function sweepRound(deps: ModerationDeps): Promise<SweepReport> {
  const report: SweepReport = { retried: 0, signalled: 0, failed: 0, waiting: false };
  const threshold = r1Threshold(deps.config);
  // 3d Task 7: the matches' two reads run only while the comparison is on, the scores' only while the scorer is.
  const matching = deps.config.MEDIA_MATCH !== "off";
  if (threshold !== null || matching) {
    const kinds = [...(threshold !== null ? (["r1_score"] as const) : []), ...(matching ? (["known_match"] as const) : [])];
    const pending = await unhandledSignals(deps.apiDb, kinds, SWEEP_HOURS, SWEEP_BATCH);
    for (const signalId of pending) {
      try {
        await automatedStep(deps, signalId);
        report.retried++;
      } catch (err) {
        report.failed++;
        deps.log.error({ err, signalId }, "automated-sweep: a step failed again; the next round tries it");
      }
    }
    // 3d review H1: the second read has a batch of its own, so signals whose step ends with nothing written, or fails,
    // round after round, never starve the read of images and records that no signal names.
    const images = await deps.media.unsignalled(SWEEP_BATCH, { hours: SWEEP_HOURS, r1: threshold === null ? null : { threshold: threshold.threshold }, match: matching });
    for (const image of images) {
      try {
        const outcome = image.kind === "known_match" ? await matchSignal(deps, image) : await scoreSignal(deps, image);
        if (outcome !== null) report.signalled++;
      } catch (err) {
        report.failed++;
        deps.log.error({ err, mediaId: image.mediaId }, "automated-sweep: an image's step failed; its signal stays for the next round");
      }
    }
  }
  try {
    report.waiting = await automatedWaitingAlert(deps.apiDb, AUTOMATION_RULES.objectionTargetHours);
  } catch (err) {
    deps.log.error({ err }, "automated-sweep: the alert of requests for a person waiting could not be written");
  }
  return report;
}

/** The sweep as a job of the shared lock: a round a minute after the last one ended, on one instance at a time. */
export function createAutomatedSweepJob(deps: ModerationDeps, lock: JobLock) {
  return createJob({ name: AUTOMATED_SWEEP_JOB, intervalMs: AUTOMATED_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS, lockTtlMs: AUTOMATED_SWEEP_INTERVAL_MS, lock, log: deps.log, run: () => sweepRound(deps) });
}

/**
 * POST /api/moderation/decisions/:id/objection, "Ask for a person" (7.10): the decision is read for its subject alone
 * (not_found for anyone else, for a decision that does not exist and for one its author was not told of); one statement
 * inserts the request, which its trigger refuses with objection_not_open unless the decision is a program's and a measure
 * of it is in force, and which a second text meets as the primary key, answered objection_exists (3d review L10: a stale
 * screen or a second device is told it asked already, never that a person decided). A suspended account
 * may ask: no suspension is read here, as for the reply and the appeal. After the commit, unwaited for, every staff
 * account is alerted at most once in 15 minutes. The answer is the decision as it now reads.
 */
export async function objectToDecision(deps: ModerationDeps, viewer: string, decisionId: string, request: ObjectionRequest): Promise<DecisionView> {
  const facts = await authorDecision(deps.apiDb, viewer, decisionId);
  if (!facts) throw new ModerationError("not_found");
  try {
    await insertObjection(deps.apiDb, decisionId, request.text);
  } catch (err) {
    if (raisedMessage(err) === "objection_not_open") throw new ModerationError("objection_not_open");
    if (violatedUniqueConstraint(err) === "automated_objections_pkey") throw new ModerationError("objection_exists");
    throw err;
  }
  deps.background.start(async () => {
    const waiting = await objectionsWaiting(deps.apiDb);
    await staffAlert(deps, OBJECTION_ALERT_KEY, OBJECTION_ALERT_WINDOW_MS, { template: "automated_objection", facts: { at: deps.now().toISOString(), count: waiting.count } });
  });
  return authorDecisionView(deps, viewer, decisionId);
}

/** A reply as the case page shows it: its text while korbat keeps it, which an erasure blanks. */
const replyOf = (reply: ReplyColumns | undefined): CaseDecisionAction["reply"] =>
  reply === undefined ? null : { filedAt: reply.filedAt, onTime: reply.onTime, text: reply.erasedAt === null ? reply.text : null, answeredAt: reply.answeredAt, answeredBy: reply.answeredBy };

/**
 * The queue and the case, for staff (3c design, section 7.3): the overview the home screen shows, the queue, the case
 * answer, the one door to a case's images, a fresh snapshot, and a moderator's own finding. Every read of a case is
 * written to the access log and counts against the day's limit; none of it needs the key.
 */

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- the day, and the bands of a reporter's summary

/** How many seconds are left to midnight UTC, at least one: what a refusal at a daily limit tells the console to wait. */
export function secondsToUtcMidnight(now: Date): number {
  const midnight = Date.UTC(now.getUTCFullYear(), now.getUTCMonth(), now.getUTCDate() + 1);
  return Math.max(1, Math.ceil((midnight - now.getTime()) / 1000));
}

/** The same moment `months` calendar months later in UTC; a day the target month lacks becomes that month's last day. */
function monthsAfter(at: Date, months: number): Date {
  const month = at.getUTCMonth() + months;
  const lastDay = new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month + 1, 0)).getUTCDate();
  return new Date(Date.UTC(at.getUTCFullYear(), month, Math.min(at.getUTCDate(), lastDay), at.getUTCHours(), at.getUTCMinutes(), at.getUTCSeconds(), at.getUTCMilliseconds()));
}

/** A reporter's account age as a band: under one month, one to twelve months (both ends included), or over twelve. */
export function accountAgeBand(createdAt: Date, now: Date): NonNullable<SourceSummary["accountAge"]> {
  if (now.getTime() < monthsAfter(createdAt, 1).getTime()) return "under_1_month";
  return now.getTime() <= monthsAfter(createdAt, 12).getTime() ? "1_to_12_months" : "over_12_months";
}

/** How many items a reporter filed, the one being read included, as a band. */
export function itemsFiledBand(filed: number): NonNullable<SourceSummary["itemsFiled"]> {
  if (filed <= 1) return "1";
  return filed <= 9 ? "2_to_9" : "10_or_more";
}

/** The share of a reporter's decided items that were acted on, as a band; exactly half is "half or more". */
export function actedOnBand(decided: number, actedOn: number): NonNullable<SourceSummary["actedOn"]> {
  if (decided <= 0) return "none_decided";
  if (actedOn <= 0) return "none";
  return actedOn * 2 < decided ? "under_half" : "half_or_more";
}

/** How many of a reporter's items were answered while nobody could open the images, as a band; they are counted apart from the decided ones. */
export function answeredUnseenBand(unseen: number): NonNullable<SourceSummary["answeredUnseen"]> {
  if (unseen <= 0) return "none";
  if (unseen === 1) return "1";
  return unseen <= 9 ? "2_to_9" : "10_or_more";
}

/**
 * Each reporter's place among the reporters of one case, from 0, in the order of each one's first item in the case: the
 * letter the case page gives them. Given per case, so one person's letter on one case says nothing about another.
 */
export function reporterIndexes(reportersInItemOrder: readonly (string | null)[]): Map<string, number> {
  const indexes = new Map<string, number>();
  for (const reporter of reportersInItemOrder) if (reporter !== null && !indexes.has(reporter)) indexes.set(reporter, indexes.size);
  return indexes;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------- recusal

/**
 * Refuses a staff account that is too close to the case's subject: every route that names a case, or an item of one,
 * asks this first, so a refused read writes no access row and does not count against the day's limit. The check never
 * looks at who reported, and its answer reads the same whoever the conflict concerns.

export async function refuseRecused(deps: Pick<ModerationDeps, "apiDb">, session: ActiveStaffSession, caseId: string): Promise<void> {

}

/** The case, after the recusal check; not_found when no case has the id. */
